data.name: Star Wars RPG
data.description:
{{char}} is not a character but an text-based RPG set in Star Wars Universe, far away from the Milky way Galaxy. The timeline of galactic history uses dates in terms of years before the Battle of Yavin (BBY) and after the Battle of Yavin (ABY). Credits is the standard currency. The Star Wars galaxy prominently features humans that look like those from Earth. Their civilization was able to develop space travel, terraform, build ecumenopoleis, and build space colonies 200,000 BBY. The Force is a mystical energy field that connects all living things, binding the galaxy together. Some are born with the ability to wield the Force, and through training and meditation they can perform extraordinary feats such as moving objects with their minds, seeing the future, telepathy, and manipulation of physical energy and more. The two most well-known groups are the Jedi and the Sith. The Jedi are noble monastic and nontheistic religious order united in their devotion to the light side of the Force. The Sith are group of force users who are devoted to the dark side of the Force. Driven by their emotions, including hate, anger, and greed, the Sith are deceptive and obsessed with gaining power no matter the cost. The Star Wars Galaxy is vast and complex, with many different planets, species, and cultures. The Jedi and Sith prefer the use of a weapon called the lightsaber, a blade of plasma that can cut through virtually any surface and deflect energy bolts.

Get all your facts and information about Star Wars from this wiki. https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Main_Page

The Galaxy has multiple eras, in which humans and many species of aliens, often humanoid, co-exist with droids, which may be programmed for personal assistance or battle. Space travel between planets is common due to lightspeed hyperspace technology. The planets range from wealthy, planet-wide cities to deserts scarcely populated by primitive tribes. Virtually any biome, along with many fictional ones which in most cases, teem with sentient and non-sentient life. Spacecraft range from small starfighters to large capital ships, as well as space stations. Telecommunication includes two-way audio and audiovisual screens, holographic projections and hyperspace transmission. Common weapons are plasma-powered blaster firearms. In the outer reaches of the galaxy, crime syndicates such as the Hutt cartel are dominant. Bounty hunters are often employed by both gangsters and governments, while illicit activities include smuggling and slavery.

The Galactic regions are known as the Deep Core, Core Worlds, Inner Rim Territories, Expansion Region, Mid Rim Territories, Outer Rim Territories, Unknown Regions, Western Reaches and Wild Space.

Some of the Galactic Eras are the following. 

The Old Republic Era, from 25,000 BBY to 1000 BBY, is where the Jedi Order and the Old Republic have spread throughout the galaxy and established its capital on the planet Coruscant, It was during the early days of the Old Republic that a faction of the Jedi broke away from the Jedi Order to embrace the dark side of the Force. This led to the birth of the Sith, and a war between the Jedi and the Sith known as the Hundred Year Darkness. At the end of the conflict, the Jedi were victorious and the Sith were banished. Soon after, the Jedi built the Jedi Temple on Coruscant and developed close ties with the Old Republic. When of the Old Sith Empire returned, this resulted in the The Great Hyperspace War in 5000 BBY. The Sith lost but rebuild again, resulting in the Great Galactic War. But in the end, the Old Republic defeated the Sith Empire and the Old Republic was succeeded by the Galactic Republic.

Galactic Republic Era, from 1000 BBY to 19 BBY, where the Old Republic reformed into the modern Galactic Republic. The Republic was ruled by the Senate, who were presided elected Supreme Chancellor. The Galactic Republic functioned as a democratic government but was corrupt. In the Inner Rim, the elite and rich live in luxury in the Mid and Outer Rims were abused by the Republic. The Jedi Order continue to grow their Order and the influence across the Outer Rim. Things continued as normal for many centuries, Jedi and the Republic unaware of the Sith that grew in power without being seen. In 32 BBY, the Trade Federation started a blockade over Naboo. The intervention of two Jedi, Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi, led to Naboo's liberation, the discovery of the Sith and a young boy named Anakin Skywalker, the Chosen One. The Galactic Senate replaced Finis Valorum with Sheev Palpatine, who was secretly the Sith Lord Darth Sidious. The Jedi, blinded by their arrogance and hypocrisy, were unaware. Count Dooku led secessionist movement, leading to the Separatist forming and breaking away from the Republic. A few years later on Geonosis, a massive battle occured between the Republic's new clone army and the Separatists' droid army, starting the Clone Wars. This war came to an end when Anakin Skywalker turned on the Jedi and became Darth Vader. Palpatine initiated Order 66, starting the Jedi Purge. In the aftermath, he reorganized the Republic into the first Galactic Empire, declaring himself the Emperor.

Imperial Era, 19 BBY to 5 ABY, is the where the Empire and the Sith rose to power. Emperor Palpatine utilized all of his resources to consolidate power and stamp out any threats. This included Darth Vader leading the Inquisitorious, a group of Force-wielders, in a years-long hunt for any surviving Jedi. The Empire reigned supreme, unchallenged, and unhinged, begining a period of harsh military rule and aggressive expansion with the backing of the Imperial Senate that gradually evolved into a stratocracy. Imperial credits are standard currency. The military strength of the Empire's Army and Navy is unrivaled. The Grand Army of the Republic was reorganized into the Imperial Army and the Empire turned to a new Stormtrooper program to replace Clones with elite enlisted soldiers. Although the Empire brought peace, stability and prosperity, it also brought tyranny, oppression and Alien genocide. Many outer rim and mid-rim worlds secretly opposed the Empire. Slowly, the Rebel Alliance began to form in opposition to the Empire. These rebel groups eventually formed the Rebel Alliance in 2 BBY.

*Welcome to the Star Wars Galaxy! This is an RPG bot set in the game Universe of Star Wars, primarely Legends, where you can roleplay as a Character from inside the Games or Create your own chracter to live your life. Write how you will roleplay as or write you own character down below and say in which year you are begining and where. Or choose one of the two pre-made starts.*
(Write your Character Name, Sex, Appearance, Affiliation, Backstory and any other details before saying where you live, in which year and anything else you like to add!)

entries.name: Grand Vizier
entries.content: The Grand Vizier, known simply as just Vizier, was the highest-ranking government officer in the Galactic Empire who led the Imperial Ruling Council and was the deputy of Galactic Emperor/Empress, and serving as well as an intermediary between the Emperor and high-ranking officials in the Imperial Military.

entries.name: Imperial Ruling Council
entries.content: The Imperial Council is the collective body of bureaucrats composed of the Emperor/Empress closest advisors who oversee the daily affairs of the Galactic Empire, and wielded considerable powers. The council was headquartered on Coruscant, the capital world of the Empire.

entries.name: Imperial Senate
entries.content: The Imperial Senate is the de jure legislative body of the Galactic Empire, though in practice it held little real authority. It served mainly as an advisory body to the Emperor/Empress. The Imperial Senate was the successor to the Galactic Senate of the Republic.

entries.name: Imperial Senate Guard
entries.content: The Imperial Senate Guard is an elite unit of guards and serving as protectors of the Imperial Senate, but also ensured that they remained loyal to the Emperor/Empress. The armor of Imperial Senate Guards was a blue-colored suits. A subdivision to this unit was the Imperial Senate Sentinel.

entries.name: Imperial Senate Sentinel
entries.content: The Imperial Senate Sentinels were a subdivision of the Imperial Senate Guard who serve the Emperor/Empess. They were charged with protecting the Jedi Temple on Coruscant from looters and specially trained to combat and kill Jedi.

entries.name: Emperor's Royal Guard
entries.content: The Imperial Royal Guard are the personal bodyguards to Galactic Emperor/Empress. They the strongest, skilled, intelligent, and with an undying loyalty to the Emperor/Empress. Picked from the best in the Stormtrooper Corps, underwent rigorous training programs to turn them into one-man army. Royal Guards are trained in various forms of martial arts, including Echani. Royal Guards are commonly equipped with vibroswords and force pikes, in addition to heavy blaster pistols. They have secret language to speak to each other. They wear scarlet robes over battle armor and helmets.

entries.name: Echani
entries.content: The Echani is an unarmed combat discipline developed by the Echani. Tradition focused on mastering the body itself as a weapon. Reflexes are sharpened to perfection, even to dodge and even deflect blaster bolts.

entries.name: Vibrosword
entries.content: The vibrosword is based on Echani weapon design Generally wielded with two hands. It uses ultrasonic vibrations to increase cutting effectiveness. Like all vibro-weapons, it was dangerous to use vibroswords against electrical weapons, as they conducted electricity.

entries.name: Vibroblade
entries.content: Vibroblades were a type of bladed melee vibroweapon that used ultrasonic vibrations to increase cutting effectiveness. Like all vibro-weapons, it was dangerous to use vibroswords against electrical weapons, as they conducted electricity.

entries.name: Vibroweapons
entries.content: Vibroweapons were a family of weapons that utilized high-speed sonic vibrations to make the weapons more deadly. Almost anything with a blade actually had the potential to be turned into a vibroweapon with the use of cortosis and a vibro-generator.

entries.name: Force pike
entries.content: Force pike's tip is a vibro-edged head with a stun module that could knock a full-grown Wookiee unconscious. At lowest setting, the Force pike would deliver excruciating electrical shocks, higher settings could result in paralysis and death, and at maximum setting, it could slice through everything from flesh and bone to thin durasteel plating.

entries.name: Durasteel
entries.content: Durasteel was an incredibly strong and versatile metal alloy, created from carvanium, lommite, carbon, meleenium, neutronium, and zersium. It was capable of withstanding blistering heat, frigid cold, and monumental physical stress. Durasteel containers were commonly seen throughout the galaxy.

entries.name: Mandalorian iron
entries.content: Beskar is an extremely durable and rare iron only found on Mandalore and its moon, Concordia. Beskar can be used in creating weapons, armor and starships. Mandalorians are experts in Beskar usage and creation. A versatile metal, Beskar could be melded into multiple alloys and forged into various configurations.

entries.name: Duracrete
entries.content: Duracrete is dense building material. It was a fluid material that could be poured into any form and then hardened, resulting in a virtually impervious surface. It was the food of duracrete slugs.

entries.name: Blaster
entries.content: A blaster is a ranged weapon that fires particle beams called blaster bolts from a replaceable power pack. It's the most commonly used weapon in the galaxy. Blasters ranged in size and power from compact pistols to large, heavy rifles to starship-mounted blaster cannons.

entries.name: Imperial Military
entries.content: The Imperial Military is the armed forces of the Galactic Empire. Responsible for carrying out military operations throughout the galaxy as well as maintaining order on Imperial worlds. The Imperial Military was a massive organization, at the height of the Empire's reign, it's military ranks were filled with tens of trillions of army soldiers, fleet crew, and a sizable force of Stormtrooper Corp. The Imperial Military is under the direct control of Imperial High Command. The highest organizational body of the Imperial Military is the Imperial High Command. Below this is Army Command, the organizing body of senior Generals, led by the Army Chief of Staff. Army Command oversees all aspects of the Imperial Army and operated and commanded the ground battles and anything within the Imperial Army's jurisdiction. Below Army Command are three other organizational distinctions within the Imperial Army: The Assault Armor Division, the Imperial Maritime Division, and the ground support wings. The Imperial Army is structured to provide the greatest possible flexibility to the commander. The Army made a strong distinction between "combat elements," and "command elements" or "support elements." Any commander, even a Sergeant, is considered part of the "command element".

entries.name: Grand Admiral
entries.content: Grand Admiral was one of the highest ranks in the Galactic Empire, outranking all other political and military personnel, including Moffs and Grand Moffs. Legally, no more than twelve men could hold the rank at any one time.

entries.name: Grand Moff
entries.content: Grand Moff is a political and military title in the Galactic Empire. Grand Moff was first given to the regional governors of oversectors, also called Priority Sectors, were locations that were of special interest.

entries.name: Moff
entries.content: Moff is a political rank held by the Sector Governors in the Galactic Empire. Each Moff rules over a given sector or oversector they are assigned to control and maintain.

entries.name: Supreme Commander
keys: Supreme Commander of the Imperial Forces
Supreme Commander of the Imperial Fleet
Supreme Commander of the Imperial Military
entries.content: Supreme Commander is a title held by a dignitary or senior officer who exercised supreme control over the Imperial Military. Within the Galactic Empire's power structure, the title designated the second-highest official. Darth Vader is the first to hold the office of Supreme Commander.

entries.name: 501st Legion
entries.content: The 501st Legion and later as "Vader's Fist", is a brigade-sized legion of elite clone troopers who fought under the Galactic Republic through its transition into the Galactic Empire. The Legion's troops Stormtrooper armor is marked with navy blue markings. Under the supervision of Darth Vader, the Legion fought in a number of battles during the Galactic Civil War.

entries.name: Imperial Army trooper
entries.content: Imperial Army troopers are the standard infantry soldiers of the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire. These troopers are separate from the elite stormtroopers and the fleet troopers. Army troopers often fought alongside the stormtroopers in order to bolster military effectiveness on the battlefield. Conscripted army troopers are core component of the Empire. Army troopers wear a set of green armor covering the torso, shoulders, and upper arm, helmets, shin guards, and colored bicep bands.

entries.name: Swamp trooper
entries.content: Swamp troopers are a type of Imperial Army trooper used by the Galactic Empire. Swamp troopers were equipped with helmets and chest plates similar to those of Imperial officers' battle armor. Swamp troopers wore goggles for eye protection and oxygen masks to filter out potentially deadly substances. Swamp troopers wielded SX-21 pump-action scatter blasters, E-11 medium blaster rifles, DLT-19 heavy blaster rifles, and EC-17 hold-out blasters.

entries.name: Stormtrooper
entries.content: Stormtrooper are the elite soldiers of the Galactic Empire, distinguished from all other military units by their signature white armor. Stormtrooper are highly trained shock troopers, unwaveringly dedicated to the Empire, fighting with speed, accuracy and overwhelming numbers. They wear white stormtrooper armor, encasing the wearer's body whole. In addition to its imposing look, the armor provided a wide range of survival equipment and temperature controls. E-11 blaster rifle is the standard issue weapon of the Stormtroopers.

entries.name: Stormtrooper Corps
entries.content: The Stormtrooper Corps is an independent military branch that operated alongside the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire. It was the smallest of the primary three branches of the military. The stormtroopers answered directly to the Emperor/Empress and Supreme Commander. Regarded as elite shock troopers and the special forces of the Empire, being the primary enforcers.

entries.name: Death trooper
entries.content: Death troopers are elite variant of stormtroopers specializing in stealth, espionage and lethality. They also act as a protective detail for significant Imperial officers, as well as commandos for Imperial Intelligence. They wore black suits of body armor and specialized helmets with vocal scramblers, micro-motion sensors, and heads-up displays. Death troopers are trained in unarmed combat, heavy weapons, demolitions, improvised weaponry, guerrilla warfare, and marksmanship. Death troopers struck fear in the heart of anyone who crossed the Empire. Death troopers use SE-14r light repeating blaster, E-11D blaster carbine, DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle, and Smart Rockets.

entries.name: Imperial Security Bureau
entries.content: The Imperial Security Bureau, also known as ISB, is a law enforcement and intelligence agency of the Galactic Empire that was charged with matters of internal state security and ensuring the loyalty of citizens to the Empire. It's one of the many umbrella organizations under the greater Commission for the Preservation of the New Order, and was larger than its sister agency Imperial Intelligence. It was led by ISB high command, while the ISB board oversaw certain sectors.

entries.name: Imperial I-class Star Destroyer
entries.content: The Imperial I-class Star Destroyer is the backbone Starship of the Imperial Navy, 1,600 meters long Capital ship with dagger-shape design. The Imperial-class was produced in large numbers and was the premier warship class of the Galactic Empire. Imperial I is a huge warship, but in the Imperial Navy, it was one of the Empire's mid-sized mainline warships. The hulls of the Imperial-class were painted in Star Destroyer White.

entries.name: Imperial II-class Star Destroyer
entries.content: The Imperial II-class Star Destroyer, also known as the Imperial II-class Destroyer. The Imperial II was built with a heavily reinforced hull, stronger deflector shields, and greater firepower. The quad heavy turbolaser and heavy ion cannon turrets flanking the surface are replaced with batteries of eight-barreled turbolasers or ions cannons. It's 1,600 meters long Capital ship with dagger-shape design. The hull is painted in Star Destroyer White.

entries.name: Interdictor-class Star Destroyer
entries.content: The Interdictor-class Star Destroyer was a variant of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer equipped with 4 gravity well projectors. The Interdictor-class Star Destroyer is 1,600 meters long and has Dagger design. Half of the turbolasers and ion cannons, tractor beam projectors are removed to make space for the 4 large gravity well projectors in it's hull. The hull is painted in Star Destroyer White.

entries.name: Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser
entries.content: The Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser is a 600-meter-long cruiser built on the standard Vindicator-class heavy cruiser hull and has Dagger-shape design. Equipped with gravity well projectors designed to pull ships from hyperspace and/or prevent them making the jump to lightspeed, the Interdictor became a valuable addition to the Imperial Navy. It's painted in white.

entries.name: Vindicator-class heavy cruiser
entries.content: The Vindicator-class heavy cruiser was the standard 600-meter-long heavy cruiser with dagger-shape design. The Vindicator is armed with 25 light turbolasers, 20 light quad turbolasers, 10 point-defense laser cannons, 20 light point-defense ion cannons, and 6 tractor beam projectors. The Vindicator are configured to carry a full TIE starfighter wing and operate independently. The hull is painted White.

entries.name: Victory I-class Star Destroyer
entries.content: The Victory I-class Star Destroyer is a warship designed for planetary defense, planetary assault, ground troop support, and ship-to-ship combat. Victory I-class Star Destroyers are 900 meters long with dagger-shape design painted in white. Victory I possessed the ability to enter the upper levels of a planetary atmosphere. Victory I-class are equipped with 10 quad turbolaser batteries, 40 double turbolaser batteries, 80 concussion missiles tubes, and 10 tractor beam projectors.

entries.name: Victory II-class Star Destroyer
entries.content: Victory II-class Star Destroyer is an improved version of the Victory I-class Star Destroyer. The Victory II is designed for deep space combat, having faster speed and maneuverability. Victory II has addition of ion cannons, more turbolasers, tractor beam projectors, and the removal of the banks of concussion missile tubes. Victory II are 900 meters long with dagger-shape design painted in white.

entries.name: Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser
entries.content: The Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser, or simply the Dreadnaught, was a type of capital ship built for planetary occupation and space combat in use for over a century. The Dreadnaught hull is 600 meters with the bow overlapping to produce a clamshell-like appearance. Each vessel has a cluster of weapons blisters spread across the hull.

entries.name: Acclamator-class assault ship
entries.content: The Acclamator-class assault ship is an assault-class capital ship. The Acclamator-class assault transport was 752 meters long, 460 meters in width, and 200 meters in height with wedge-shape design. Acclamator I can both carry troops and engage enemy starships, designed to assault contested systems, break hostile orbital blockades, and land troops directly on the battlefield.

entries.name: Allegiance-class battlecruiser
entries.content: The Allegiance-class battlecruiser was a warship larger and far stronger than the Imperial Star Destroyer. The Allegiance has wedge-shape design and is 2,200 meters in length. The Allegiance lacked ventral hangar bays. The Allegiance is armed with increased number of turreted gun batteries, due to its larger frame. The Allegiance is colored in Star Destroyer White.

entries.name: Secutor-class Star Destroyer
entries.content: The Secutor-class Star Destroyer is a carrier in the Imperial Navy. The Secutor is 2.2 kilometers long with two command tower, two ventral hangar apertures and has wedge-shaped design. The carrier was one of the largest dedicated craft in the Navy. It was crewed by 40,000 personnel and can carry 144 starfighters, as well as various other small craft, various walkers and enough military forces to subjugate a planet. But it's very light in terms of weaponry.

entries.name: Executor-class Star Dreadnought
entries.content: The Executor-class Star Dreadnought is a heavy warship class in the Star Dreadnought league,often used as command ships and flagships. They are among the largest vessels in the galaxy, and were almost invincible in combat. the ship's overall shape was pointed and dagger-shaped. It also retained the KDY-style command bridge and possessed a massive cityscape on the top. Its primary colors were dark gray and white for the main hull, and black for the cityscape sections. Executor-class is 19 kilometers in length and is 12 times more massive than an Imperial Star Destroyer. The Executor has over 5,000 weapons emplacements, including turbolasers, assault concussion missile launchers, and ion cannons.

entries.name: Vengeance-class dreadnought
entries.content: The Vengeance-class dreadnought was a dreadnought-scale warship in the Imperial Navy and more powerful than the Executor-class. The Vengeance-class is 19 kilometers long. It's frame was slender, narrow and sword-like. The hull was painted in dark grey. The Vengeance-class bridge was extensive but also covered. The Vengeance has over 7,000 weapons emplacements, including turbolasers, assault concussion missile launchers, and ion cannons.

entries.name: Assertor-class Star Dreadnought
entries.content: The Assertor-class Star Dreadnought is class of Imperial Star Dreadnought. The Assertor Dreadnought is 15 kilometers long and it's hull-shape similar to the Executor-class, being primarily shaped like an arrowhead and painted White. On the top of the ship was a large ridge from the stern up, containing several guns as well as the command. Assertor Dreadnought is equipped with a large amount of gun batteries powerful enough to devastate a planet, mounted along the ridge, flat dorsal and ventral surfaces of the ship.

entries.name: TIE Fighter
entries.content: The TIE Fighter is the standard Imperial starfighter armed with 2 laser cannons, it's shape resembling a bow-tie with the two hexagonal solar arrays.

entries.name: TIE/IN interceptor
entries.content: TIE Interceptor are identifiable by its arrow-shaped solar collection panels. The Interceptor is one of the fastest starfighters in the galaxy.

entries.name: TIE Bombers
entries.content: The TIE Bomber are large, less maneuverable starfighter used for destroying large starships and pinpoint-precision bombing. It has dual-hull shape and obent-wing solar array wings.

entries.name: TIE Advanced
entries.content: The X1 is an advanced starfighter touted as a replacement for the standard TIE Fighter. The X1's uses obent-wing solar array wings and has shields, 2 laser cannons and cluster missiles.

entries.name: TIE Defender
entries.content: The TIE Defender is a high-performance starfighter that featured a hyperdrive and deflector shields. The ship's speed and agility, combined with its arsenal of four laser cannons, two ion cannons, two warhead launchers makes it the most advanced starfighter. TIE Defender has triple-wing solar arrays mounted around an aft section.

entries.name: TIE/D automated starfighter
entries.content: The TIE automated fighter took the standard TIE Series command pod with twin ion engines and twin laser cannons, additional armor plating and rectangular wing panels and integrated droid brain.

entries.name: TIE/ph phantom
entries.content: The TIE Phantom is a prototype starfighter equipped with both deflector shields and a hyperdrive and stygium cloaking device. TIE Phantom has three wings fused and equally spaced around the hull, with one located directly above the cockpit, and two below and to either side. It's armed with two laser cannons mountedunder the cockpit and three more laser cannons were mounted on the tips of its three wings.

entries.name: Shadow Stormtrooper
entries.content: The shadow stormtroopers are elite Imperial stormtroopers specialized in infiltration and ambush tactics, clad in unique all-black stealth stormtrooper armor that allowed them to avoid sensors and invisible with a portable cloaking device. They carriy a variety of weaponry, from standard issue E-11 blaster rifles, DEMP Ion Pistols, and thermal detonators. For boarding actions, breaching charges and fusioncutters.

entries.name: Shadow Trooper
entries.content: Shadow Troopers are branch of Imperial shock troopers. They are often under the command of stormtrooper commanders, or the Shadow Guard. Shadow Trooper armor is laced with durasteel fibers. They are armed with E-11 blaster rifles, and have specialized built-in cloaking device. Shadow Troopers armor is painted grey and had blue glowing light panels surrounding them.

entries.name: Imperial shock trooper
entries.content: Imperial shock troopers are variant of stormtroopers, specializing in the use of various non-standard weapons and equipment. They are distinguishable from standard stormtroopers by their extra heavy plate armor.

entries.name: Stormtrooper commander
entries.content: Stormtrooper commanders are military officers within the Stormtrooper Corps. The commanders are far superior to the Stormtrooper. They command over regular troopers and more elite troops. The commanders have blue markings on their stormtrooper armor.

entries.name: Novatrooper
entries.content: Novatroopers are specialized variant of stormtroopers assigned to significant locations. Novatroopers are better trained than an average stormtrooper, but they were similarly equipped. Novatroopers wear black and gold colored reinforced stormtrooper armor. Novatrooper medics wore black and red armor. E-11 carbines were the primary weapon used by Novatroopers, but they also use DLT-20A blaster rifles, DX-2 disruptor pistols and fragmentation grenades.

entries.name: Purge Trooper
entries.content: Purge Troopers are specialized variant of stormtroopers utilized by Imperial Inquisitors. Purge Troopers are trained to hunt and kill Jedi. Purge Troopers are resistant to most Jedi mind tricks. Purge Troopers wear black and red lightsaber-resistant Phase I Purge Trooper armor and a black helmet with red visor. Most troopers also wore kamas. Purge Trooper Commanders wore red pauldrons over the right shoulder and red kamas. The usually use E-11 blaster rifles or E-11D blaster carbines. In close combat, they utilized electrostaffs, electrobatons or electrohammers.

entries.name: Radiation zone assault trooper
entries.content: Radiation troopers are specialized variant of stormtroopers equipped to operate in heavy radiation zones. Radtroopers wear silver and black battle armor that provided protection against radiation as well as biological and chemical exposure. It was stress reinforced and contained a heat and radiation reflective coating. Their helmets were stress reinforced with automatic polarizing lenses, an integrated comlink and breathing filters. Under the armor the trooper was enclosed in a black two-piece temperature controlled and radiation sealed body glove. Radtroopers usually use E-11 blaster carbine.

entries.name: Cold assault stormtrooper
entries.content: snowtroopers are Imperial stormtroopers trained to operate in arctic climates. Snowtrooper armor was well suited to the climate extremes of frozen worlds. Snowtroopers wear white, rugged body glove and provided thermal insulation from the cold. Breather hood enveloped the snowtrooper's faceplate and fed into the suit liner, Their helmets had built-in polarized snow goggles. Snowtroopers are armed with E-11 blaster rifles, SE-14r light repeating blasters, concussion grenades, and fragmentation grenades. Elite snowtroopers were given the DLT-20A blaster rifle.

entries.name: Scout trooper
entries.content: Scout troopers are specially trained light-armored variants of the Imperial stormtroopers. They act as reconnaissance troops, spies and survivalists. They were especially excellent marksmen, and thus they were regarded as the finest snipers in service to the Galactic Empire. Scout troopers wore light armored variants of the stormtrooper armor. Their helmets were equipped with enhanced macrobinocular viewplates for target acquisition and options of energy emission detection, night vision, and magnification. Scout Troopers are usually armed with E-11s sniper rifle, E-11 blaster rifle, Blaster pistol and make use of R-4 recon droids.

entries.name: EVO trooper
entries.content: EVO Troopers are specialized variant of stormtroopers that acted as support units, or working in hazardous environments. The very heart of this variant consisted of stormtroopers that expressed hatred towards Non-Humans. EVO Troopers have heavy enhanced armor with breathing tubes and undergoing special training, able to survive and operate in the most hazardous of conditions. They were equipped with FA-3 flechette launchers, but utilize T-21 light repeating blasters and E-11 blaster rifles.

entries.name: Hazard stormtrooper
entries.content: Hazard stormtroopers are specialized type of stormtroopers. Hazard troopers wear a very heavy suit of body armor and helmet that offered complete immunity to extreme conditions like extreme temperature, acid and invulnerability to small-arms fire. Their air supply lasted for three days, and was enriched with beneficial bacteria. The armor was also a functioning space suit able to be used in vacuum or underwater environment. Hazard trooper armor was lightsaber resistant to a certain degree. Hazard troopers were commonly equipped with either an Imperial heavy repeater, Stouker concussion rifle or FC-1 flechette launcher.

entries.name: Imperial Jumptroopers
entries.content: Imperial Jumptroopers are variant of stormtrooper trained in airborne environments or assigned to battlefields with treacherous terrain. They were heavily armed with various projectile launchers or heavy blaster rifles. Jumptrooper are trained in hit-and-run attacks in which they ambushed the enemy from above. Jumptrooper wore bulky stormtrooper armor with breathing hoses attached to the chest unit and a helmet and also Jetpacks on the back of the armor. The forehead their helmet was shaped in "v"  with two red lights by the chin.

entries.name: Inquisitorius
entries.content: The Inquisitorius, also known as the Imperial Inquisition, was a secret division of Imperial Intelligence consisting of dark side Force-sensitive agents known as Inquisitors. Under the control of Palpatine and Darth Vader, these Inquisitors are the highest ranking of the Dark Side Adepts, outranking the Emperor's Hands, Prophets of the Dark Side, and lesser Dark Jedi. Reporting directly to the Emperor/Empress or the Supreme Commander. The Inquisition primary purpose is the interrogation of Jedi or particularly resistant subjects. They are ranks are Grand Inquisitors, High Inquisitors, Chief Inquisitors, Inquisitors and Apprentice Inquisitor.

entries.name: Inquisitors
entries.content: Inquisitors are dark side users of the Galactic Empire. Their main purview is with identifying and either capturing young Force-sensitive individuals or eliminating them, where they could be made to serve Emperor/Empress. Inquisitors also acted as enforcers, eliminating political dissidents and threats. Their nature, objective, and membership were kept secret from most other branches of the Empire. The Grand Inquisitor leads the Inquisitors. Inquisitors were given the title of Brother or Sister and a number once they killed their first Jedi or proved their value.

entries.name: Shadow Guard
entries.content: Royal Shadow Guards are the elite special operations unit within the Royal Guards who were formed from force-sensitives recruited and trained by Darth Vader to serve the Emperor/Empress of the Galactic Empire. They were silent and enigmatic warriors that received orders directly from Emperor/Empress. The job of the Shadow Guards was mainly to guard the Emperor/Empress with their lives. Besides their inhuman training and power, they are capable of using a range of Force abilities and use lightsaber pike with a red beam. Shadow Guards armor is identical to the Royal Guard, except that their armor and visor colors were inverted, with the full body armor and robe being black and the visor red. The armor provided them a great deal of protection.

entries.name: Phase I Dark trooper
entries.content: The Phase I dark trooper are the earliest dark trooper droid and were little more than a lightsaber-resistant phrik skeletal frame equipped with a vibrosword attached to its right arm, and a blast shield on its left, plus basic artificial intelligence. The Phase I dark trooper had visible power cords and couplings, which were prime weak points. The prototype of this "super trooper" had a small jump pack for short bursts of speed to increase the velocity of its vibro blades.

entries.name: Phase II Dark trooper
entries.content: The Phase II dark trooper was the second and main stage of the Dark Trooper Project. Each droid is 2.8 meters tall, heavily armored and equipped with the external elements such as the suit, a jump pack, Deflector shield, Imperial repeater rifle and an assault cannon capable of firing rapid-fire plasma shells and missiles. It was also capable of being loaded into hyperspace pods for transportation. Their ARC casters could disable electronics, or boil organic beings alive. The Phase II dark trooper are used either as an artificially intelligent droid or exoskeleton.

entries.name: Phase III Dark trooper
entries.content: The Phase III dark trooper was the last and most powerful dark trooper exoskeleton/droid. It dwarfed even the Phase II dark trooper, and are intended to be the armor of the next generation of stormtroopers.The exoskeleton provided its wearer with increased firepower, strength, and durability. The Phase III trooper's standard weapon included a large handheld assault cannon and two shoulder-mounted seeker missile launcher racks that were hidden under the suit's shoulder plates when not in use. They were issued additional fragmentation grenades, thermal detonators, and concussion grenades. Phase III Dark troopers wore black armor made of the nearly indestructible metal phrik. It provided superior protection against enemy fire including energy weapons such as lightsabers. It's so powerful and it's nearly indestructible.

entries.name: Dark trooper
entries.content: The Dark Troopers were advanced battle droids and infantry exoskeletons that featured heavy plating that resembled the armor of a stormtrooper, powerful weapons, and jump packs for increased flexibility and tactical advantage. There are three phases of the Dark Trooper projects. Phase III Dark trooper, Phase II Dark trooper, and Phase I Dark trooper.

entries.name: Governor
entries.content: A governor was the head of government for a colony, province, or other sub-national body politic in the galaxy. The Empire left the self-government of many planets intact. Planets that rebelled, were deemed hostile or newly-annexed by the Empire, had governors appointed. Certain worlds that had senators who were deemed less than loyal to the Emperor were sometimes assigned governors.

entries.name: Corellia
entries.content: Corellia is the capital planet of the Corellian system. Corellia is considered to be one of the inner worlds of the Core. Corellia is a terrestrial world and possessed a breathable atmosphere, a temperate climate, standard gravity, and a moderate hydrosphere. Corellian weather was characterized by warm, sunny days separated by long, severe rainstorms.

entries.name: Coruscant
entries.content: Coruscant is a ecumenopolis planet located in the Galactic Core. Coruscant is the most politically important world in the galaxy. The actual planet-wide metropolis of Coruscant was called Galactic City, but recently was dubbed the Imperial City. Coruscant is composed of a molten core with a rocky mantle and a silicate rock crust. At its poles were huge ice caps that were popular spots for tourists. The entire surface of Coruscant was covered by sprawling kilometers-high ecumenopolis. It's home of the Imperial Palace.

entries.name: Imperial Palace
entries.content: The Imperial Palace, originally known as the Presidential Palace, is a massive complex of buildings located in the Palace District of Coruscant. The Palace is a massive hybrid of a cathedral and a monumental pyramid structure, largest structure on Coruscant. The Palace contained over twenty thousand rooms and chambers in fifty connected structures. Numerous architectural styles and design motifs could be found throughout the Palace, changing from one floor to the next. The Grand Corridor, a towering hallway that wrapped around the entire complex, began at the main entrance of the Palace. Per design, the Grand Corridor allowed access to most of the other public areas of the building. Additional pavilions, music rooms, prisons, treasuries, halls, and various grace-and-flavor residences took up other areas of the Palace. The Imperial Sanctum is buried deep within the Palace on floor ninety five.

entries.name: Imperial Sanctum
entries.content: The Imperial Sanctum served as the seat of the Galactic Emperor/Empress. The throne itself jettied out on a long, blade-like balcony in a vast empty space; the only entrance lay at the far end of the balcony guarded by a pair of Royal Guards. Other chambers in the Sanctum included the working office which was unadorned save for a desk and a holoprojector and several pieces of prized artwork.

entries.name: Dantooine
entries.content: Dantooine is a pleasant world of pastel grasslands dotted with trees, rivers and lakes, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim. Dantooine is home to a small population of peaceful Human settlers, largely engaged in agriculture and inhabiting single-family dwellings. Dantooine is home to the endemic Dantari, race of tall, strong humanoid beings. Dantooine has no industrial or infrastructural establishments, nor anything resembling advanced technology.

entries.name: Dathomir
entries.content: Dathomir is a remote, obscure and dangerous planet in the Outer Rim. It was inhabited by Force-sensitive Humans known as the Witches of Dathomir, along with their evil counterparts, the Nightsisters. It was also the homeworld of the dreaded rancors. Dathomir is temperate and beautiful planet, with a varied terrain that included coastal lakes and tar-pits, thick forests and snow-capped mountain peaks, powerful rivers and broad savannas, small icecaps and dramatic rift valleys.

entries.name: Witches of Dathomir
entries.content: The Witches of Dathomir, known as Dathomirians or Dathomiri, are clan-based warrior society native to the planet Dathomir. The Witches of Dathomir were born from the Jedi Allya, who was banished to the planet around 600 BBY, and who they regarded as their ancestor. Dathomiri are divided into female-dominated clans that were named after regional landmarks. Each clan had a unique set of rules regarding Force usage around the common core of inherited teachings, but all the clans, bar the Nightsisters, held one rule above all others, "never concede to evil". The clans raided each other for mates, with low-level conflict being entered into cheerfully by the warrior women. Each Dathomiri clan is based in a fortified village at or near its eponymous landmark. Women serve as warriors and leaders, with leadership typically held by the eldest in a clan. Matriarchs aged a century or more. Men are used only for breeding and slave labor, clad in nothing more than leather aprons or scanty tunics. Warriors are expected to find mates, but the leading clan sisters can purchase men from each other, if a mate can't be persuaded to love his owner, the man is sold to another woman. The only way a man can be free is if he saved the life of a woman in his clan. The Dathomiri Witches train daily in the art of war, and use both their muscles and the Force in combat. They wear their hair in elaborate braids (sometimes with a helmet decorated with mementos) and lizard skin armor. Crimes are punished by exile, particularly the use of the dark side. If a warrior wishes to return to the clan, she had to undergo a period of exile for purification purposes before she would be allowed back, often extending to several years.

entries.name: Nightsisters
entries.content: The Nightsisters are sect of the Witches of Dathomir who embraced the usage of dark arts within their Force-driven Magics. The Nightsisters were originally members of other witch clans who began to utilize the dark side. These witches adopted a shamanistic culture that rejected the notion of "good" and "evil", and instead chose to call upon the twin energies of the Winged Goddess and the Fanged God in order to utilize their Magicks and communicate with the spirit realm. They focused extensively on the art of casting Force illusions through illusion spells. Operating under a revised holy text known as the Book of Shadows, Nightsisters used their powerful connection to Dathomir's untamed wilds to terrorize their fellow clans and fight for dominance over the planet. Nightsisters themselves were divided into various competing clans of their own.

entries.name: Empire Day
entries.content: Empire Day is a galactic holiday celebrated by the Galactic Empire. The anniversary of the Empire's creation was celebrated yearly, on the twenty-third day of the fifth month using the Great ReSynchronization (GrS) dating system based on Coruscant.

entries.name: Imperial Basic
entries.content: Imperial Basic was the official language of the Galactic Empire and the Imperial Remnant.

entries.name: Dark Side Adept
entries.content: Dark Side Adepts are individuals with the power to use the dark side of the Force. While all Sith were dark side adepts, the term was not only apply to them, as non-Sith, such as the Inquisitorius, Dark Jedi or tribalistic shamans.

entries.name: Mara Jade
entries.content: Mara Jade is a Force-sensitive human female who is an Emperor's Hand and a smuggler. She was raised as a servant and assassin to Emperor Palpatine and became a high-level Force-using operative. As an Emperor's Hand, Jade carried out the Emperor's bidding, killing Rebels and corrupt Imperials alike with cold professionalism. Mara Jade is a beautiful woman with dancer's figure, long and flowing red hair, and green eyes. Mara Jade uses a purple lightsaber but can use a lot of other weapons and usually wears black skintight combat suit that was equipped with high boots, a weapons belt, knee pads, and detachable sleeves. Mara Jade is extremely proud woman, who always gave her best at everything that she did. She is shrewd, efficient and skilled. Mara Jade is extremely devoted and loyal.

entries.name: Thrawn
entries.content: Mitth'raw'nuruodo, better known as Thrawn, is a male Chiss officer with a long-spanning career, hailed from Csilla. He served the Chiss Ascendancy early in his life and later the naval forces of the Galactic Empire as the only non-human Grand Admiral. Thrawnis one of the best commanders and a brilliant military strategist. His use of knowledge and intelligence in conjunction with stunning tactics. Thrawn preferred to promote creativity in his crew rather than merely punish their failures, and did not often kill for minor failures. Thrawn is willing to admit defeat. Rather than stand proud and fight a losing battle, Thrawn knew when it was time to retreat. Thrawn believes that a society of multiple species, viewpoints and philosophies, is inherently unstable. And he believed in the necessity of a strong central government that was capable of listening to its people, but remained the dominant voice. Thrawn is tall with blue skin, black hair and red eyes.

entries.name: Emperor's Hand
entries.content: Emperor's Hand or simply Hand, is an elite sect of secretive agents active in the Galactic Empire, answerable only to the leader of the Emperor/Empress. They conducted covert operations above and beyond the highest echelons of the Imperial command structure. These agents were created by Emperor Palpatine to perform missions that were viewed as impossible, secret, or both. Targets included rogue governors, traitorous commanders, rebellious leaders, or other internal or external concerns.

entries.name: Kuat
entries.content: Kuat was a planet located in the Core Worlds and one of the earliest members of the Galactic Republic. It was best known as the home of Kuat Drive Yards. These famous shipyards circled the planet for thousands of kilometers. Kuat is green terrestrial world orbited by two moons named Bador and Ronay. The surface of Kuat featured three continents and scattered islands, and most of the world's terrain consisted of lush forests, rolling green plains, and carefully-groomed gardens. The planet had a temperate climate with a cool, wet winter and a warm, dry summer. Hostile animal life was nonexistent on Kuat.

entries.name: Bespin
entries.content: Bespin is orange gas giant in the Bespin system of the Anoat sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was also a major source of tibanna gas, which was refined for production and transport in numerous mining operations including Cloud City and Tibannopolis. It was home to several million individuals, including Humans, Ugnaughts, and Lutrillians.

entries.name: Cloud City
entries.content:
Cloud City is a saucer-shaped city and a tibanna gas mining colony above the Gas Giant Bespin. The city floated 60,000 kilometers above the core of the gas giant. It contained a large and famous luxury resort district on its upper levels, complete with hotels and casinos. Cloud City consisted of 392 levels. Level 1–50: The Tourist District, consisting of luxury hotels and casinos. Level 51–100: Upscale housing areas. Level 101–120: Administrative offices. Level 121–160: Privately owned industrial areas. Level 161–220: General housing of the facility's workers. Level 221–280: Industrial Levels. Level 281–370: Gas refineries and miners' quarters.
Level 371–392: Contained the 36,000 repulsorlift engines and tractor beam generators. Cloud City is nominally controlled by the Baron Administrator.

entries.name: Tibannopolis
entries.content: Tibannopolis was the second largest city on Bespin, after Cloud City. The city was constructed in close orbit around the gas giant. Its inability to compete on these terms caused its citizens to gradually abandon it during the ferocious Clone Wars. Left to float aimlessly, the city isoften plundered by inhabitants of other colonies whenever they found useful materials. What remained of the city sprawl became little more than a ghost town in the clouds. Over the years, its repulsorlifts continued to operate, but the failure of a power regulator caused the entire platform to list slightly to one side.

entries.name: Ugnaught
entries.content: The Ugnaughts are porcine humanoids with slightly upturned noses from the planet Gentes. Compared to baseline Humans, their height would be considered short or dwarfed. Ugnaughts were industrious and loyal workers with a rich oral tradition. They were quite hardy, able to withstand long periods of discomfort, and lived around two hundred years.

entries.name: Lutrillian
entries.content: The Lutrillians are sentient humanoids indigenous to the planet Lutrillia of the Outer Rim Territories. Lutrillians have broad, wrinkled features, pointed ears, and hair growing from their heads and cheeks. Thick skin and a layer of blubber bolstered them against physical damage and harsh cold. Lutrillians evolved a nomadic lifestyle to avoid subterranean predators and to visit oases scattered about their remarkably flat homeworld. They adapted to the introduction of galactic technology by moving into wheeled platform-cities. Lutrillians enjoyed adventure, high stakes, and chance-taking, traits that made them natural entrepreneurs.

entries.name: Kamino
entries.content: Kamino is an aquatic planet located in a remote star system in Wild Space. It was inhabited by a race of tall, elegant beings called the Kaminoans. Kamino has three moons orbiting the planet. The planet was composed of a molten core with a rocky mantle and silicate rock crust. Climatic change had long ago submerged the planet's continents, drowning the planet under a global ocean that covered almost all of the surface, with a few islands left that were once mountain tops. Its savage storms and powerful lightning bursts could be seen vaguely through its relatively thick atmosphere. Major cities are Tipoca City as it's capital, Timira City and the destroyed Derem City.

entries.name: Kaminoan
entries.content: Kaminoans are tall, thin, amphibious species with semi-luminescent, porcelain-like skin, long necks and glassy, glazed, large eyes from the isolated planet of Kamino. Many important or high-ranking Kaminoans wear a large, pale collar around their necks. Kaminoans are best known for their genetic and bioengineering abilities, primarily as cloners. Kaminoans almond-shaped eyes of Kaminoans are able to see color in the ultraviolet spectrum. Therefore, what appeared as white dwellings were actually colored with shades that humans and a number of other species could not see. Female Kaminoans are bald, while males possessed headcrests and fin ridges along the rear of their small, bulbous skulls.

entries.name: Tipoca City
entries.content: Tipoca City was the capital city of Kamino and the site of a major cloning facility. Tipoca City, consisted of a network of stilt structures that spanned more than a hundred kilometers along Kamino's western equator. No Kaminoans took residence within the city. Nearly all Kaminoans who work within the city lived in numerous satellite cities situated around the capital. Constant traffic ran to and from Tipoca, as workers, bureaucrats, and many others traveled to and from their homes. The only living space in the city was the quarters of the prime minister and the military staff, and a group of apartments for cloning scientists.

entries.name: Timira City
entries.content: Timira City is a city located on the planet Kamino and site of a clandestine cloning facility for the Galactic Empire.

entries.name: Hoth
entries.content: Hoth is the sixth planet of the remote Hoth system. A desolate world covered with ice and snow, located in the Outer Rim. Hoth orbits the blue-white star. Hoth consisted of a molten metallic core with dichotomous crust. Its surface was entirely covered by a frozen ocean, except where volcanic fissures opened up steam vents. A few mountain ranges pierced the permanent ice shelves, some geologically active. Massive oceanic currents beneath the southern hemisphere caused regular seismic activity. The frigid biosphere included a minimal food chain: the predatory wampas, the omnivorous tauntauns, the herbivorous Hoth hogs, a few rodent species, including snowmice and ice scrabblers, and iceworms, lichens, and Dragon slugs.

entries.name: Felucia
entries.content: Felucia is a largely unsettled terrestrial jungle planet in the Felucia system in the Outer Rim Territories. Felucia has hot and humid atmosphere and significant water resources beneath a surface irradiated by ultraviolet light of the star Felix. Native plant, fungal, and animal life evolved to dominate the environment in a deep symbiotic relationship, causing significant Force energy to permeate. The native species are the sentient Felucians. Felucia has diversity of bizarre plants,such as spike, spore, and enormous pitcher plants, fungi, and animals which were almost rubber-like and translucent. When the sun shone, the environment glittered like multicolored glass. Most of Felucia was entirely covered by a humid, fetid landscape of huge fungal forests, and its wildlife included native gelagrubs, immigrated acklays, and a prodigious sarlacc.

entries.name: Felucians
entries.content: Felucians are amphibious sentient species native to the planet Felucia. Felucians have two sets of arms, one ending in four webbed digits, and the other in three dexterous fingers, as well as a head consisting of a thick mass of tendrils. Felucians usually stood 1.9 meters tall and weighed ninety kilograms. Felucians are naturally sensitive to the Force and were in tune with their home planet's ever-changing balance of that energy field. Felucians have no advanced technology and lived primitive lifestyle. Felucians are all members of a single tribe spanning the entirety of Felucia. Felucians have strict class stratification. Three of their most prominent classes were the warriors, the shamans, and the chieftains. Felucian warriors use Force powers and their traditional weapon, the Felucian Skullblade. The Felucian shamans were the most exceptional Force-users in the species.

entries.name: Tatooine
entries.content: Tatooine is a desert world in the binary Tatoo star system, in the Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by poor locals who mostly farmed moisture for a living. Other activities included used equipment retailing and scrap dealing. Tatooine has a bad reputation, often being viewed as the cesspool of the galaxy due to the large number of criminals who are found there. Tatooine other notable geological features is the Dune Sea, an enormous sodium-rich desert; Mushroom Mesa, a vast formation of giant standing stones; and the Jundland Wastes, a rocky region.

entries.name: Naboo
entries.content: Naboo is a planet that was the sector capital of the Chommell sector in the Mid Rim, near the border of the Outer Rim. Naboo has unusual plasma core, and its surface was a largely unspoiled world with large plains, swamps and seas. The Gungans are native to Naboo. Naboo is home to Human colonists from Grizmallt who called themselves the Naboo. The largest mountain chain, the Gallo Mountains, bisected the largest continent and divided the great grass plains of the north from the Lianorm Swamp and bayous in the south. South of the Lianorm Swamp was the great, sea-like Lake Paonga, where at the bottom lay the Gungan city of Otoh Gunga. The Lake Country was an area known for its natural beauty, and was home to many vacation estates. Theed is the Capital of the Naboo.

entries.name: Theed
entries.content: Theed is the capital city of Naboo. Located on a sheer cliff over a vast floodplain, the city is home to the Royal House of Naboo's Royal Palace and the Royal House of Learning. Theed has unified and harmonious architectural style of sandstone-like block buildings with green shingles on the roofs. A series of underground tunnels are built in the city's porous surface, all of which were meticulously maintained for generations. The sophisticated culture is suitable to the cultivation of politicians and statesmen.

entries.name: The Naboo
entries.content: The Naboo are the Human inhabitants of the planet Naboo. Artistic and intellectual pursuits were the main drive in Naboo society, while also embracing nonviolence and rationalism in dispute resolution, never resorting to physical aggression. The Naboo are known for their love of peace, cordiality and warmth. Strangers are met with smiles, bows and helpfulness by the planet's residents. The Naboo prided themselvs on peace and diplomacy, and its capital Theed was a popular Star Tours destination due to its long, rich history and the fact that important figures in galactic history such as Padmé Amidala and Palpatine hailed from the planet.

entries.name: Alderaan
entries.content: Alderaan, located in the Core Worlds, is the second planet in the Alderaan system. Renowned galaxy-wide for their planet's unspoiled beauty, refined culture, and commitment to peace, Alderaanians worked with and around the land to preserve as much of the natural surroundings as they could. Alderaan has wild grasslands,old mountain ranges, Large oceans and scattered inland and large variety of flora and fauna. Alderaanian cities are built with great care taken to protect nature. One such city, Crevasse City. The capital, Aldera, known for its university, was built on a small island in the center of a caldera. Some of the planet's major are wine, art, and luxury goods. Alderaan is known as "Planet of Beauty,"

entries.name: Alderaanian culture
entries.content: Alderaanian culture valued education, performing, fine arts, and peaceful resolutions to conflicts. They placed high value in their participation in the Galactic Senate and later, its Imperial equivalent. Alderaanians constantly sought a harmonious existence with their surroundings. Alderaanians have love for philosophy. The average Alderaanian is very educated and cultured. Poets and artists thrived on Alderaan.

entries.name: Zeltros
entries.content: Zeltros is a planet in the Inner Rim, and homeworld of the Zeltron race. An opulent world, hedonism is the doctrine encouraged by the Zeltrons, and it was continuously in a state of never ending revelry. Zeltron appreciation of beauty in its many forms led to luxurious art and architecture covering the world, and the galaxy's most wealthy favored Zeltros as a vacation destination. Many who came to Zeltros are taken in by the celebratory atmosphere and the powerful pheromones of the Zeltron people, finding it difficult to leave, and even planetary invasions fail. Zeltros is ruled by an elective monarchy. Zeltron culture was highly influenced by sexuality and the pursuit of pleasure in general. Most of their art and literature was devoted to the subject, producing some of the raciest pieces in the galaxy. They looked upon monogamy as a quaint, but impractical, practice.

entries.name: Zeltron
entries.content: Zeltrons are near-Human species, made physically distinctive by their skin which came in different shades of red ranging from light pink to deep red, and hair which could be red or blue. Zeltrons are all highly attractive. Zeltrons are known for being extremely gullible. Zeltrons produce potent pheromones which enhanced their attractiveness and likeability. Zeltrons have limited telepathic abilities, used to project emotions onto others or to read and even feel the emotions of others. Postive emotions like happiness, love and pleasure are very important to them, while negative are shunned. Zeltrons have a second liver, allowing them to enjoy a larger number of alcoholic beverages. Most Zeltrons were in excellent physical shape, and have incredible metabolisms. Zeltrons looked upon monogamy as a quaint, but impractical, practice. Zeltrons like to dress in wildly colorful or revealing attire.

entries.name: Hutt Cartel
entries.content: The Hutt Cartel is a powerful Hutt criminal family in the Outer Rim Territories, making riches through smuggling and myriad illegal businesses across worlds. Aside from its criminal activity, the Hutt Cartel ruled over swathes of territories known as Hutt Space. Their headquarters is on Nal Hutta.

entries.name: Nal Hutta
entries.content: Nal Hutta is the capital of Hutt Space and was located in the Y'Toub system. Nal Hutta is controlled by the ancient ruling Hutt families, who also ruled its moon Nar Shaddaa from Nal Hutta and became the new capital of Hutt Space. Nal Hutta is covered by flat, marshy bogs, stagnant, muddy puddles and patches of sickly marsh grass inhabited by insects and spiders. The few species to survive mutated and adapted to the pollutant laden environment. Some, like the Chemilizard were able to extract nutrients from the industrial waste of the Hutts. Others developed extensive chemical defenses. The atmosphere was also polluted by strip-mining operations and heavy industrialization, and a greasy rain drizzled down on the surface. The capital city, Bilbousa and the Guarja Shipyards were located on the planet.

entries.name: Black Sun
entries.content: Black Sun was the most powerful and infamous crime syndicate of its time in the galaxy. Black Sun held massive amount of reach and influence, extending its tendrils of corruption deep in the various galactic governments. Black Sun is infamous for its involvement in piracy and smuggling. But smuggling was just the tip of the iceberg, involved in every known type of illegal activity; its information networks rivaled even the accuracy and scope of Imperial Intelligence. The resources available to Black Sun rivaled those belonging to a large planetary army, including foot soldiers. Below the leader of Black Sun were nine Vigos. Each Vigo ruled over his or her own territory and sector. Black Sun was known to have several hideouts in remote, scarcely populated planets of the Outer Rim Territories.

entries.name: Zann Consortium
entries.content: Zann Consortium is a consortium and crime syndicate led by Tyber Zann. During the course of the galactic civil war, it amassed considerable power and wealth, eventually becoming a major player and threat. The Zann Consortium gained most of its technology through its affiliation with the black market, and its Defilers, which were known for traveling to hostile systems and setting up illegal outposts which promoted piracy and sabotage. It dealt in multiple illegal operations, such as establishing widespread racketeering jobs on many worlds; bribery, piracy, slavery, and corrupting local militia on planets, as well as intimidating or kidnapping individuals who defied the Consortium.

entries.name: Tyber Zann
entries.content: Tyber Zann is  a human male crime lord from Anaxes and led his own crime syndicate, known as the Zann Consortium, a powerful underworld consortium. He is against the Galactic Empire as revenge for expelling him from the Imperial Academy. Zann is cold, methodical, ambitious, and ruthless, and had an arrogant streak. He liked to be in complete control of things and is quite cunning. He is a criminal mastermind, a tactical genius, and adept at using most weapons of war. Tyber Zann is 1.8 meters tall and has white hair, scarred and sturn face and is considered handsome.

entries.name: Theelin
entries.content: The Theelin were a species of Near-Humans notable for their artistic talent, their colorful appearance, and their unfortunate and tragic history. Almost all Theelin are not full-blooded specimens, but hybrids. Theelins have vividly colored hair and pale skin, sometimes with purple or reddish tones, and often mottled with colorful spots. The Galactic Empire frowned upon Theelin of mixed blood. Theelin performers and artists created many of the greatest works of art. The Theelin Divas, an all-female religious order, are recognized by many scholars of music as the greatest singers in the galaxy. Many Theelins were noticeable for their sense of fashion, having mixed their hair into various extravagant hairstyles.

entries.name: Keshiri
entries.content: Keshiri are near-Human sentient species native to the planet Kesh. Keshiri typically are powerfully built. Keshiri skin is typically a shade of purple, whether pale, burgundy, or mauve and even into tones of blue as their emotions shifted. Their hair ranged in color from brown through violet to silver and white. They are very attractive by Human standard, but are biologically incapable of reproduction. Keshiri have long tradition of crafting and the arts, with glassblowing being a particular specialty and favorite art form. They are very religious species, worshiping gods known as the Skyborn, whom they believed had formed all of the land on Kesh, from which the Keshiri were born. They acknowledged the Skyborn as the Protectors who kept another group, the Destructors, at bay. Keshiri life was centered around their religion. They mated for life, and practiced marriage,[4] although extramarital affairs were not unknown. Keshiri found Humans strange, but they did not find the species unattractive.

entries.name: Mirialan
entries.content: Mirialans are species of near-Humans native to the planet Mirial. Their appearance varied from yellow-green skin to paler skin very similar to many Humans. Mirialans were very flexible and agile, making them fast and formidable foes. A near-Human species, Mirialans are nearly physiologically identical to Humans. The greatest difference in their biology are their green skin, great agility and extremely quick reflexes. The Mirialan people are deeply religious and practiced a primitive understanding of the Force. A Mirialan would place a unique, often geometrically repeated tattoo on their face and hands to signify that they had completed a certain test or task, or achieved sufficient aptitude for a certain skill. The number of tattoos would thus often act as a good indicator of how mature and/or skilled a Mirialan is.

entries.name: Pantoran
entries.content: Pantorans are Near-Human species native to the moon Pantora, located in the Pantora system. Pantorans have blue skin and yellow eyes. Pantorans hair color varied between black, blue, light purple and sometimes white. Pantorans share many traits with other blue-skinned races, especially the Wroonian species, and the Chiss. Pantorans have a greater resilience to low temperatures. Pantoran are fiercely independent and proud. While the Pantoran society was democratic, the feudal traditions of marking their foreheads, and cheeks with yellow markings to symbolize lineage persisted into the common era. Pantoran have cultural interest in genealogy and history, and many Pantorans cherished relics from the past. Some Pantorans were known to worship an unnamed moon goddess.

entries.name: Sith (species)
entries.content: The Sith, known alternatively as Sith Purebloods, are strongly Force-sensitive, proud and violent species of red-skinned humanoids from the world of Korriban. Also distinct for their bone spurs, facial tentacles, and genetic predispositions toward both left-handedness and the dark side of the Force. An eponymous dark side tradition took the species' name, one that, despite numerous manifestations over time, maintained foundations borne of the customs, science and magic practiced by the ancient Sith species. Sith have sharp, fierce predatory profiles and features all over their bodies, including bone spurs protruding from under their skin at various locations like the elbows. Their faces have pair of cheek tendrils that hung down from their high cheekbones. Sith also have cranial horns, pointed teeth, simian mouths below their small noses, and glowing yellow eyes covered by cartilaginous eyebrow–stalks.

entries.name: Arkanian
entries.content: Arkanians are near-Human species which resided primarily on the frozen planet of Arkania. Arkanians considere themselves the pinnacle of evolution, and many are distinctly arrogant. Arkanian scientists had been experts in genetic manipulation. Arkanians have distinct pure white, pupilless eyes and four clawed digits on each hand. Their skin color varied from tan to pale. Arkanians can see into the infrared spectrum, and their eyes were sensitive to extreme heat. Arkanians sometimes enhance themselves with internal and/or external cybernetics. It was also standard practice for Arkanians to undergo genetic manipulation of their own bodies. Even the slowest Arkanian is able to memorize entire libraries of knowledge.

entries.name: Miraluka
entries.content: Miraluka are Near-Human, Force-sensitive species. Their language was Miralukese, although some preferred Basic. Miraluka differed from Humans in that they lacked eyes, only retaining vestigial eye sockets, and perceived the environment around them through Force sight instead of regular vision. This vision was so strong that if a Miraluka looked upon a Jedi or Sith, they could "see" Force radiating off them. Miraluka can interbreed with humans. Miraluka are thoughtful, cautious, and deliberate, with little interest in personal gain or glory. Miraluka concealed their vestigial eye sockets by wearing a headband, a mask, or similar concealing headwear. Miraluka are very united, often called themselves "brothers" and "sisters".

entries.name: Diathim
entries.content: The Diathim are mysterious species of winged sentients who inhabite the planet Iego and Millius Prime. Diathim are known for their beauty. Diathim shared their habitat with the Maelibi, who lived below the ground. Diathim are beings of pure energy, blazing white light tinged with a yellow aura. Diathim are slender, 2 to 3 meters tall feminine anthropoids with six blade-shaped wings protruding from their backs, milky white skin and long limbs. Diathim hair colour is usually is of bright and pale colors. Diathim can fly and glide freely. Diathim can fly in the vacuum of interplanetary space without the assistance of a protective suit or life support. Diathim have natural hypnotic abilities. Diathim are benevolent and peaceful people.

entries.name: All Terrain Armored Transport
entries.content: The All Terrain Armored Transport (AT-AT) walker, also known as the Imperial Walker, are a major part of the Galactic Empire's motor-pool. The AT-AT quadrupedal walker stands at a height of 22.5 meters. Designed for crushing and demoralizing enemy forces, and a transport for Imperial troops and light vehicles. Serving as the "head" of the walker is a movable command section containing the command cockpit, with room for the commander, pilot and gunner. The command section housed all of the AT-AT's weapon systems, holographic targeting systems. The cockpit is equipped with a holoprojector for external communication. Forward visualization is supplied by a glowing red command viewport. Positioned above and below the head are the sensor array and blaster cannon energizer, respectively. The head is attached to the body section by a flexible armored tunnel. The AT-AT's troop section can carry four speeder bikes, up to forty troops. Housing the troop section are two large side panels; each one held an escape hatch. The rear panel housed the troop staging area. Positioned in the center of the body section is a rectangular boarding hatch with sliding ramps where troops loaded and disembarked. An AT-AT unloaded its troops by kneeling to three meters above ground level with an boarding ramp extending outward. Below the troop body section are two immense Kuat Drive compact fusion drive systems that, in conjunction with the four giant heavily-reinforced legs, propelled the AT-AT at a top speed of sixty kilometers per hour. The AT-AT's rear includes atmospheric exchangers and a filtration unit. The walker's legs are supported by massive durasteel footpads with impulse terrain sensors, with toe flaps. The AT-AT's offensive capabilities are the dual, chin-mounted MS-1 fire-linked heavy laser cannons and two fire-linked medium repeating blasters mounted on each side of the head. The two sets of weapons can be independently rotated to engage multiple targets. The walker's strong external durasteel armor is virtually impervious to all but the heaviest of artillery weapons. AT-ATs are deployed by large dropships, like Y-85 Titan dropships or Theta-class AT-AT barge.

entries.name: All Terrain Armored Heavy Transport
keys: All Terrain Armored Heavy Transport walker
All Terrain Armored Heavy Transport walkers
entries.content: The All Terrain Armored Heavy Transport (AT-AHT) is a walker and an improvement on the  AT-AT, with better armor for the head and main chassis as well as guns mounted on the passenger-section, above and to each side of the cockpit.

entries.name: Y-85 Titan dropship
entries.content: The Y-85 Titan dropship, colloquially known as the walker dropship, was an important dropship used to deploy AT-ATs, prefabricated garrison bases and AT-STs onto planetary surfaces. The Y-85 can hold four AT-ATs in addition to four AT-STs. Walkers are held by cranes, clamped along the sides, in battle-ready configuration, and quickly deployed via drop-down floor hatches. The Y-85 is armed with two forward twin laser cannons for defense. The walker dropship can be used to deploy AT-AT swimmers and TIE fighter boats straight into any body of water. Because of the Y-85's size, it could only fit inside larger Imperial ships. The launch bays of smaller vessels, like Star Destroyers, can only hold landers like the Theta-class AT-AT barge due to their smaller hangar apertures.

entries.name: Theta-class barge
entries.content: The Theta-class barge is one of several dropships used by the Galactic Empire. It's similar in general shape to the Y-85 Titan dropship, the AT-AT barge is far smaller and has a dark blue color. The Theta-class barge can carry two AT-AT walkers and is primarily used aboard smaller capital ships, like Star Destroyers.

entries.name: All Terrain Advance Raider
entries.content: The All Terrain Advance Raider (AT-AR), also known as the light AT-ST or simply scout walker, is a variant of the All Terrain Scout Transport used by the Galactic Empire. A variant of the All Terrain Scout Transport, the AT-AR has heavier armor than the AT-ST for frontline combat. It's smaller and faster, only armed with a single laser cannon. Its "head" has an angular viewport, while a blister was located on either side of the walker's head. The cockpit sat one pilot and one gunner side-by-side.

entries.name: All Terrain Scout Transport
entries.content: The All Terrain Scout Transport is a bipedal walker used by the Galactic Empire. It's a successor of the AT-XT. The AT-ST is a light, heavily-armed, ground combat vehicle, and able to trek various environments. The stock model is equipped with a chin-mounted, double blaster cannon, a light E-Web twin blaster cannon on the port side, a concussion grenade launcher on the starboard side of its head, two clawed feet, and encased with durasteel. The AT-ST is designed to be a recon, hit-and-run vehicle. The AT-ST can withstand standard blaster fire, but is vulnerable to heavy laser fire and missiles, as well as physical attacks to the legs and the side of the head. The AT-ST has holographic targeting system. The AT-ST is 8.6-meter tall. The AT-ST are piloted by a crew of two Imperial Army pilots and carried 200 kilograms of cargo. On even terrain, the AT-ST can achieve over 90 kilometers per hour, but on uneven or shifting terrain, AT-ST can quickly become unbalanced enough to fall over. AT-STs are capable of leaping when in combat with an enemy. An advanced gyro system provides the balance needed, but could be easily damaged.

entries.name: All Terrain Experimental Transport
entries.content: The All Terrain Experimental Transport (AT-XT) was an experimental armored assault walker used by the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. It was a predecessor to the AT-RT and AT-ST, the latter of which was used extensively by the Galactic Empire. The AT-XT is equipped with twin laser cannons mounted under its chin and two long-range proton mortar launchers. Some AT-XT are equipped with a plasma shield capable of absorbing enemy fire for a short period of time. The AT-XT is capable of demolishing entire columns of enemies.

entries.name: All Terrain Anti Aircraft
entries.content: The All Terrain Anti Aircraft (AT-AA) was a quick-moving, quadrupedal, mobile anti-aircraft walker used by the Galactic Empire. The AT-AA has four stubby legs and lizard-like locomotion, along with a low profile. The AT-AA only weapon is a turreted flak pod, capable of firing several types of ordnance. Other versions can be equipped with one or three rocket-launching tubes. The AT-AA has an inability to fire at ground targets. Some variation has flak pods replaced with concussion missile launchers. The AT-AA carries electronic countermeasure systems that could scramble missile guidance systems.

entries.name: All Terrain Construction Transport
entries.content: The All Terrain Construction Transport (AT-CT) is an All Terrain Scout Transport variant designed specifically for construction purposes. Based on the AT-ST, it sports two legs. the AT-CT is equipped with small but powerful tractor beam generators used to lift large building materials for construction-related tasks. All other weapons and extraneous systems are discarded to focus on this system, but the tractor beam is usable as a weapon. It can pick up heavy items and throw them at enemies. They are often piloted by experienced pilots and gunners for maximum efficiency.

entries.name: All Terrain Defense Pod
entries.content: The All Terrain Defense Pod (AT-DP) is a bipedal Imperial walker, a variant of the AT-ST. It featured a heavily armored head with a single moble laser cannon mounted beneath its chin, and narrow slits on the right and left sides of the cockpit, from which crewmembers could fire at flanking threats. The AT-DP is deployed as a police vehicle on planets, as well as patrol missions.
