The AT-DP is quite similar to the All Terrain Advance Raider with which it shared the armored cockpit and central laser cannon.

entries.name: All-Terrain Exploration Droid
entries.content: The All-Terrain Exploration Droid (AT-ED) is a model of exploration droid developed in collaboration between Cybot Galactica and Kuat Drive Yards, designed to assist in the exploration and surveying of newly discovered planets. The AT-ED is similar to the AT-ST or the AT-PT, but lacks the chin-mounted blaster cannons. It has a single side-mounted heavy blaster for armament. The AT-ED is two and a half meters tall. The AT-ED has good balance and easily traversed rough terrain. Its chassis is full of antennae, microphones, photoreceptors, and sensors which could make detailed maps kilometers into the distance or up to fifty meters of rock. Their complex systems are difficult to maintain and expensive.

entries.name: All Terrain Personal Transport
entries.content: The All Terrain Personal Transport (AT-PT) is a light anti-infantry walker used by the Galactic Empire. It's manufactured by Rothana Heavy Engineering, a subsidiary of Kuat Drive Yards. Made to take a single trooper into an intense combat situation on his own. AT-PTs are made to take single troopers into intense combat situations on their own, with the firepower of a squad. AT-PT stood three meters tall. The AT-PT are capable of reaching speeds up to 60 kilometers per hour and can climb a 45-degree angle, with hydraulic adjusters keeping the unit balanced. The AT-PT carry a long-range comm antenna. The cockpit entry hatch is on the side, while the emergency flare launcher is above the viewport. The AT-PT are heavily armored enough so that small-arms fire could not penetrate the AT-PT. The AT-PT is armed with twin blaster cannons and a concussion grenade launcher, which were only effective against infantry. The AT-PT superior agility made up for its light armor. The AT-PT often traveled in packs for increased firepower.

entries.name: Self-Propelled Medium Artillery
entries.content: The Self-Propelled Medium Artillery (SPMA) walker is an artillery piece used by the Galactic Empire. The SPMA are fitted with a long-range, variable trajectory turbolaser cannon, and due to its modular design, it can be deployed with specific payloads for different missions. Most of the SPMAs are equipped with 12 light anti-infantry blasters that emerged from the ventral surface of the vehicle when in use.

entries.name: Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery
entries.content: The Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery (SPHA) walker, also known as the Mobile Assault Cannon (MAC), are modular heavy artillery unit used by the Grand Army of the Republic and the Galactic Empire afterward. Depending on the configuration, the walker had different names: SPHA-T (turbolaser), SPHA-I (ion cannon), SPHA-V (anti-vehicle laser), SPHA-C (concussion missile launcher), SPHA-M (mass-driver cannon) and SPHA-F (thermobaric cannon). The SPHA) has twelve legs that served as mobile support structures. The SPHA units are deployed directly from landed Acclamator-class assault ships or other Landers. SPHA walkers usually received orders from ground-based command posts. SPHA units have a complement of 30 troopers, who could deployed rapidly via a dorsal hatch.

entries.name: Mark 1 droid walker
entries.content: Mark 1 automated walkers were small automated AT-PT-like battle droids used by the Galactic Empire. They are armed with two blaster cannons and a concussion grenade launcher.

entries.name: Mountain Terrain Armored Transport
entries.content: The Mountain Terrain Armored Transport (MT-AT) are an arachnid-like eight-legged walker, apparently designed on the Galactic Empire's fortress world of Carida. This design earned it the nickname "Spider Walker". Each MT-AT walker is deployed on-planet by a cocoon pod and emerged from the impact crater fully operational. These cocoon pods encased the walker in a fluid gel that protected its descent to a planet's surface. A droid brain in the pod controlled the speed and direction and activated decelerating thrusters shortly before impact. When the pod impacted on the surface, the bistate gel hardened, absorbing the kinetic energy and protecting the walker from damage.

entries.name: Carida
entries.content: Carida, originally known as Ord Carida, was a planet of the Colonies region of the galaxy, near the Perlemian Trade Route, and the homeworld of the Caridan race. This large, high-gravity world was covered in everything from rocky mountains and frozen ice fields, to rain forests full of carnivorous plants, and deserts. As such, this planet was the perfect training ground for combat in difficult terrain. It was an exporter of food, and was ruled by the Council of Merchants, which later shared power with a military administration.

entries.name: Caridan
entries.content: The Caridan are a mammalian species of Carida. Average Caridans stood over two meters tall and have dense musculatures due to Carida's high gravity level. They spoke Caridan and most also spoke Basic. Caridan society is structured around a mercantile culture led by an active market and Caridan owned industrial firms. The Caridans are widely known for their appraisal and bartering skills. The Caridans cooperated with the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire in the operation of the Academy of Carida. The Empire's xenophobia ignored the Caridans outside the Imperial compound, although tensions grew after the Battle of Yavin.

entries.name: Carida Academy
entries.content: The Carida Academy is a private, and later state-supported, comprehensive military institution. The institution was known by a variety of names such as Caridan Military Academy, Academy of Carida, Academy at Carida, its unofficial name among the Cadets is Cliffside because of its precarious geographic location, on the Spinara Plateau: a five-hundred-foot dropoff along the east side. The Academy itself is less than one-tenth of the larger, sprawling Imperial Military Training Base, which typically housed more than one hundred and fifty thousand personnel, mostly human males (mirroring the trends of the Imperial culture), including the recruits, cadets, and instructors. The Academy formed a triumvirate of elite military institutions along with the academies of Anaxes and Corulag and as such it produced a high number of Imperial officer corps.

entries.name: Corulag
entries.content: Corulag is a populated terrestrial planet located on the Perlemian Trade Route in the Corulus system in the Bormea sector, part of the Ringali Shell. It was the endpoint of the Corulag-Jatir Hyperroute. The planet boasted urban sprawls with the underdeveloped areas filled with bamboo forests. It's near the Ringali Nebula and shared the sun Corulus with Solag, Biolag, and Garulag.

entries.name: Metellos
entries.content: Metellos is the fourth of seven planets in the Metellos system of the Coruscant sector in the Core Worlds region. The planet orbited one star, also called Metellos, and in turn was orbited by three moons. Metellos is located on the Metellos Trade Route, a hyperlane on which it lay between the Norkronia system and Coruscant. A terrestrial world with a diameter of 12,600 kilometers, Metellos has three moons and featured a breathable atmosphere, temperate climate, and standard gravity. With the exception of a few seas and desert wastelands, the surface of Metellos was entirely urbanized. Seventeen large stratablocks were present on Metellos, and structures such as these reached heights as great as one kilometer above the planet's surface, tapering off into single-story structures. Many tracts, especially those situated far away from the stratablocks, were shabby, environmentally toxic, and occupied by diseased squatters. In spite of its problems, Metellos is highly developed planet. Metellos is governed by a bureaucracy and exported business services and advanced technology while importing foodstuffs and office supplies. More than 1,000 floating cities, constructed by the wealthy executives of the planet to compensate for overcrowding, drifted 1,200 meters above housing precincts. Designers modeled these cities after the herd cities of Ithor.

entries.name: Ithor
entries.content: Ithor is the fourth planet located in Ottega system of the Mid Rim. It's a planet full of lush life, and the planet's surface had not a touch of civilization on it. The Ithorians themselves, otherwise known as "Hammerheads," built great floating cities that did not harm the surface, which they considered to be sacred. Entry upon the surface is forbidden, unless one stayed there permanently. The Ithorian religion's personification of Ithor's world-spanning jungle. The surface of the planet of Ithor played host to numerous plants, including the bafforr tree, which possessed telepathic capabilities. The planet contained andurite stone, and every three Ithorian years was the center of the Time of Meeting. The planet has many moons in its night sky.

entries.name: Alsakan
entries.content: Alsakan is an ecumenopolis world in the Alsakan system in the Core Worlds. A Core Founder on the Perlemian Trade Route, Alsakan is an ancient, wealthy world that had been a major political player for centuries, and was responsible for the seventeen Alsakan Conflicts that had been fought with Coruscant over the nature and shape of the early Galactic Republic. Alsakani culture and values came to dominate the Human-majority worlds of the Perlemian, which championed local independence and limited government. A wealthy planet, at the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY, Alsakan is able to afford one of the earliest Star Dreadnoughts for the Alsaka sector's local defense forces. Xenvaer is a city on Alsakan. Archais was an ancient region of Alsakan, and Rucapar one of its major cities. Built among five equidistant mountains, Rucapar had been the site of the Alsakan Mosaics, an ancient Wonder of the Galaxy that stretched in five lanes of tiles to each mountain.

entries.name: Axum
entries.content: The third planet in the Axum system, Axum is a terrestrial world orbited by two moons. Axum sat along the Perlemian Trade Route, with Alsakan being considered a stopover between Axum and Coruscant. A strong industrial world with a large population, Axum is one of the Core Worlds' mightiest urbanized worlds and dwarfed the industrial output of her sister planet Anaxes—an industrial powerhouse in its own right. Both Axum and Anaxes are well-known for manufacturing high-tech goods. The thirty-five thousand Brass Soldiers of Axum was a mysterious wonder on the planet.

entries.name: Anaxes
entries.content: Anaxes is a fortress world located on the Perlemian Trade Route in the Axum system of the Core Worlds. Known as the "Defender of the Core", for millennia it was the site of the Republic Navy's primary fleet base and War College. It's considered the site of naval power, tradition and prestige by both the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire. Anaxes shared its sun, Solis Axum, with Selgon, Grastes, Axum, Urfon, Phlors Rex, Phlors Regina, and Ichium. Anaxes is now the command center for the Imperial Center Oversector. Upon the creation of Azure Hammer Command, whose Super Star Destroyer Whelm and fifty-seven other capital ships defended Sector Zero, Anaxes is chosen as its command base. A separate command called Azure Shield is created to protect the Azure sector and its neighbors.

entries.name: Azure Hammer Command
entries.content: The Azure Hammer Command or the Coruscant Sector Army is an Imperial Sector Army tasked with defending of the Coruscant sector. The Coruscant Sector Army mighty fleet boasted the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Whelm along with 57 other capital ships. Anaxes served as the fleet's primary command center.

entries.name: Atrisia
entries.content: Atrisia, also known as Kitel Phard, is a terrestrial planet with several continents on its surface, located in the Core Worlds sector known as the Atrisian Commonwealth. It lay on the Giju Run hyperlane and was the homeworld of the creature known as the shredder bat. Locations on the planet included the city of Jar'Kai and the Atrisian Imperial Historical Library. Atrisia is inhabited by a race of Humans known as the Atrisians. The predatory creature known as the shredder bat was first encountered on the planet but eventually spread to more than a thousand other worlds.

entries.name: Atrisian
entries.content: The Atrisians were Humans native to the planet Atrisia.

entries.name: All Terrain Scout Transport/Assault
entries.content: The All Terrain Scout Transport/Assault (AT-ST/A) is a variant of the AT-ST walker. AT-ST/A is 10 meters tall, and is more heavily armed than the AT-ST, sporting a large, single-barreled heavy blaster cannon instead of the double medium blaster cannons. The AT-ST/A's legs have greater reinforcement, and its gyro-stabilizing systems were improved from the original design. It's fit with enclosed viewports for added protection of the crew.

entries.name: All Terrain Riot Control Transport
keys: All Terrain Riot Control Transport Walker
All Terrain Riot Control Transport Walkers
entries.content: The All Terrain Riot Control Transport (AT-RCT) is a model intended roles of crowd control and riot suppression in urban areas. It's was based on the AT-RT. It's used by the Imperial Army and the police forces of Galactic Empire, as well as many planetary and system governments. The AT-RCT is open-topped but larger in scale. It has room for two pilots.

entries.name: Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations
entries.content: The Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations (IOCI), is the primary law enforcement agency of the Galactic Empire and answered to the Coalition for Progress, a part of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order. Led by a director, the IOCI is responsible for investigating and fighting criminal activities. IOCI manages the Imperial Enforcement DataCore, a database for posted bounties. The jurisdiction of the IOCI included most of the known galaxy. As such they frequently worked with local law enforcement agencies, Imperial Intelligence, and various branches of the Imperial Military. They also worked with the Imperial Security Bureau, the Empire's secret police. The ISB focused more on political investigations while the IOCI strictly focused on the enforcement of criminal law. Alongside the regular police officers and investigators in its employ, the IOCI had two elite operatives. The first were the Sector Rangersand the Special Enforcement Officers.

entries.name: Sector Ranger
entries.content: The Sector Rangers were established during the days of the Galactic Republic as the Senate mandated the creation of a universal police agency, charged with apprehending criminals and keeping the peace, a concept duplicated in each sector of the Republic. While local law enforcement agencies were restricted by jurisdictional boundaries, the Sector Rangers are able to pursue criminals anywhere within a given sector or even beyond to bring them to trial. The Rangers usually traveled in pairs or groups of four for particularly dangerous assignments. They are organized in teams composed of the crew of a Ranger ship, typically a small transport. Rangers are capable starfighter pilots. In addition to their own ships and droid complements, Sector Rangers have the right to commandeer local policemen or make use of Imperial vessels in the course of their duties, although most avoided doing so unless the situation required methods. Rangers are trained to be cautious and methodical in their gathering of evidence or employment of their powers, so as not to have criminals be released due to legal loopholes and mistrials.

entries.name: Special Enforcement Officer
entries.content: Special Enforcement Officers (SEOs) are elite police officers generally recruited from the ranks of the Sector Rangers. They have wider arrest and detention powers which allowed them to cross sector boundaries in pursuit of a criminal. Special Enforcement Officers are experts at investigations, interrogation, and tracking and are remarkably observant. They are highly intelligent and had a breadth of knowledge on a variety of topics. Special Enforcement Officers conducted undercover operations or investigated high profile cases and they were more independent than the regular Sector Rangers.

entries.name: Coalition for Progress
entries.content: The Coalition for Progress is a sub-agency of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order, or COMPNOR. It began as a weak cultural organization, understaffed and underwhelming, but developed into a massive information-gathering agency with monitors throughout the galaxy. It examined massive amounts of data, the majority of which was mundane, for indications of dissident or Rebel activity, and forwarded summaries to the more-important Imperial Security Bureau. Each sector had a Sector Monitor, a collection of agencies whose intended purpose was to report on the cultural progress within a sector toward the enhancement and perfection of the New Order, and did rough sorting of data by division type. Below the Sector Monitor were the various divisions made up of COMPNOR members dispersed throughout the systems of the sector.

entries.name: Sector Monitor
entries.content: A Sector Monitor was a collection of agencies that were part of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's Coalition for Progress. They collected and sorted data on cultural progress within a sector, divided into five separate branches; Art, Science, Commerce, Education, and Justice.

entries.name: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
keys: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
entries.content: The Commission for the Preservation of the New Order (COMPNOR) is a government agency for various entities of the Galactic Empire that were designed to maintain support for Emperor Palpatine's New Order. The New Order is strongly supported by COMPNOR. It criticized the perceived decadence and weakness of the Republic, and advocated an authoritarian and militaristic social and political culture. The New Order emphasized Human and, to a lesser extent, near-Human supremacy, with other alien species subjected to discrimination or outright slavery. Antislavery laws were repealed and legislation legalizing the persecution of aliens was passed. The vast majority of the government officials are composed of Humans, with only rare exceptions like Grand Admiral Thrawn climbing in the ranks of the military. A high degree of male chauvinism was also seen in the Empire's military and government. Combining this with the alien persecution, the Empire was often referred to as having pro-Human policies.

entries.name: Imperial Intelligence
entries.content: Imperial Intelligence Service, also known as Imperial Intelligence, Military Intelligence and abbreviated as Imperial Intel or I.I, is the primary intelligence service for the Galactic Empire. It's dedicated to collecting information, secret and otherwise, for the Imperial government and was a rival to the Imperial Security Bureau. Organized into central bureaus, themselves divided into divisions, and with various other units and operations in addition to the central bureaus. The agency made use of covert operations which it used to spy on its enemies as well as itself and other branches of the Galactic Empire. They are responsible for watching the activities of various governments, corporations and other forces in the galaxy. Furthermore, the keep an eye out for any notable mercenary, bounty hunters and other outlaw activities. They supply any information to the various branches in the Imperial Military regarding any potential targets and strategies, which made them valuable despite being kept off the front lines.

entries.name: Clone troopers
entries.content: Clone troopers were highly trained soldiers in the Grand Army of the Republic. During the last years of the Galactic Republic, clones formed the backbone of the Republic Military. Clone troopers were grown on the planet Kamino. Clones were modeled on a human template, the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett, although their genetic structure was modified to make them less independent and more docile than their progenitor. They were also designed to age at twice the rate of natural humans. Clones initially served as Imperial stormtroopers in the New Order, but were soon replaced by human recruits and conscripts. In addition to the standard Clone troopers that composed the bulk of the clone army, a select number of clones were trained for specialized roles, such as piloting and command. More clone trooper variants were deployed, from jet troopers and flame troopers to Advanced Recon Commandos and Covert Ops clone troopers. Regular clone troopers can carry heavier weaponry and armor and carry the designation of Heavy clone trooper and Repeater clone troopers.

entries.name: Council of Moffs
entries.content: The Council of Moffs, also known as the Moff Council or Moff Assembly, is the deliberative body of Moffs if the Empire is to fall and followed by the Imperial Remnant. As its governing body, the council could execute large-scale decisions with consensus. Its delegations were responsible for their own sectors and weirded significantly influence.

entries.name: Cybot Galactica
entries.content: Cybot Galactica (CG) is one of the two largest droid manufacturing companies in the galaxy, the other being Industrial Automaton.

entries.name: Kuat Drive Yards
entries.content: Kuat Drive Yards, KDY, or Kuat Engineering is the largest military shipbuilding corporation in the galaxy at the time of the Galactic Civil War. It's based on the planet Kuat. Kuat Drive Yards mainly sold its products to the Galactic Empire, and the Galactic Republic previously. Many Kuat products could be found in TIE Fighters, armored fighting vehicles such as AT-STs and AT-ATs, Star Destroyers, and other military vehicles. Kuat Drive Yards did not sell only to the Imperials, many planetary governments purchased its weapons for the purposes of defending their planet from the war. These circumstances helped to make Kuat Drive Yards one of the most famous corporations in the galaxy.

entries.name: Rothana Heavy Engineering
entries.content: Rothana Heavy Engineering is a clandestine subsidiary of Kuat Drive Yards. Its headquarters was located on the eponymous planet of Rothana.

entries.name: Rothana
entries.content: Rothana is a remote planet in the Rothana system located in Quiberon sector, near the edge of the Outer Rim Territories and Wild Space, most famous for being the headquarters of Rothana Heavy Engineering. A snowy world with arctic terrain, Rothana's wildlife is adapted to the freezing conditions. The Rothanian arctic horny whelmer had a wide, squatting, sturdy stance that was mimicked in the design of the RHE All Terrain Tactical Enforcer. As the headquarters of Rothana Heavy Engineering, a subsidiary of Kuat Drive Yards, the planet's economy was almost entirely based around shipbuilding and developing military vehicles. Rothana was surrounded by a vast honeycomb of orbital shipyards and drydocks for KDY's secret constructions. The planet is protected by a formidable KDY corporate-security starfleet.

entries.name: Santhe/Sienar Technologies
entries.content: Santhe/Sienar Technologies, owned by the Santhe Corporation, is a massive umbrella corporation based on the planet Lianna in the Tion Cluster that manufactures an exceptionally wide range of vehicles and weapons. Originally Republic Sienar Systems, Santhe/Sienar Technologies provided numerous starships for the Galactic Republic for many millennia. A short-lived subsidiary, Sienar Design Systems, produced the Sith Infiltrator. Though they denied any involvement in the ship's design, SDS was forced to shut down due to intense scrutiny from the Senate. A century before the Battle of Yavin, the Sienars united with the Santhe family, who owned Santhe Security, due to an arranged marriage. Santhe/Sienar originally did not invest in the Corporate Sector Authoriy. However, the company realized they could not ignore the large discount on raw materials available to their competitors, and invested as a voting sponsor following the establishment of the Corporate Sector.

entries.name: Tagge Company
entries.content: The Tagge Company, usually shortened to TaggeCo, is a company owned by the House of Tagge. It was also an Imperial Corporation. TaggeCo, like the House, is based in the city of Unlos Tagge on the planet Tepasi. It's one of the largest megacorporations in the galaxy. It's the parent company of Biscuit Baron, Bonadan Heavy Industries, GalResource Industries, Gowix Computers, Lantillian ShipWrights, Mobquet Swoops and Speeders, Tagge Industries Shipyards Limited, Tagge Mining Company, Tagge Restaurant Association, and Trast Heavy Transports. It also sponsored the Team Tagge swoop racing team.

entries.name: House of Tagge
entries.content: The House of Tagge, also known as the Tagge family is a family of wealthy Human nobles centralized on Tepasi. The head of the family holds the rank either of baron or baroness, depending on sex. The House of Tagge owned and operated the Tagge Company, one of the most powerful megacorporations in the galaxy, as well as a private military of 5,000 armed scout starships and a million soldiers. They supported the Galactic Republic throughout the Separatist Crisis and Clone Wars—although they did not offer the Republic the use of their paramilitary forces—and following the Declaration of a New Order, are firm supporters of the Galactic Empire. The current head of the family is Baron Orman Tagge and Baroness Sanya Tagge.

entries.name: Corporate Sector
entries.content: The Corporate Sector or "CorpSec" is a sector located in the galaxy's Outer Rim that was governed by the independent Corporate Sector Authority. It's the largest corporate territory in the galaxy. The Corporate Sector is located in the Outer Rim Territories, rimward to the Aparo and Wyl sectors, at the end of the Hydian Way. The sector included thousands of inhabited systems along with more than one hundred thousand uninhabited systems.

entries.name: Corporate Sector Authority
entries.content: The Corporate Sector Authority, commonly abbreviated to CSA, is a corporate authority that controlled the Corporate Sector, which is located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. All economic, political and judicial systems are controlled by member corporations or corporate interest, who were charted to directly administer the sector. During the Imperial Period, the Corporate Sector Authority is  never part of the Galactic Empire and retained its independent, with the Empire maintaining official diplomatic relations with the CSA. The government of the Corporate Sector Authority is made up of several powerful corporations. These companies are managed by the Direx Board, which ismade up of 55 members, all of whom are high-ranking business executives. The Direx Board is led by Executive officer, and other posts included Prex (President), Viceprex, Auditor-General and the Imperial Advisor that represented the interests of the Galactic Empire. The Corporate Sector Authority has much less racial discrimination than the Humanocentric Galactic Empire, although it advertised on the appeal of being free of alien interests. The Security Division of the Corporate Sector Authority is responsible for law enforcement of it territories.

entries.name: Imperial Charter
entries.content: The Imperial Charter or Constitutions of the New Order is the highest set of laws in the Galactic Empire. It represented the branch of Imperial legal statutes concerned with constitutional law. One of the Charter's passages stated that senators could not question an edict of the Galactic Emperor. It also included segments detailing the relationships (including political, military, colonial, transportation, and economic) between the Imperial government and the local systems it ruled.

entries.name: Imperial Security Bureau
entries.content: The Imperial Security Bureau (ISB), also referred to as the Imperial Security Office or the Imperial Secret Service, is an internal security and intelligence agency of the Galactic Empire that was charged with defending it against security threats from within and ensuring the loyalty of citizens in the Empire. It's led by ISB high command, while the ISB Board oversaw certain sectors. The ISB is a sister agency and rival to Imperial Intelligence. The Bureau works closely with Emperor. On the field, ISB is sometimes attached to various fleets, sometimes falling under the command of the Navy and working alongside Naval intelligence. Members of the ISB work from the ISB Central Office, while agents in the field would constantly provide intelligence updates to headquarters. The ISB used a martial structure to their organization's ranks. Many military officers feared the ISB and its power. Prospective ISB personnel are drawn from the Imperial Academy system and given training within the ISB Academy and Offices complex. Members go through a training regimen which included learning xenophobic propaganda, and are taught from the ISB Loyalty Manual. Members of the ISB are taught a specialized vocabulary to prevent outsiders from understanding their conversations. The term "auditing" is used to signal that suspects knew they were being investigated. The practice of provoking a suspect to commit a crime was referred to as "crustbusting," and interrogating a supposed innocent in the hope that they would react suspiciously was known as "scattering." High-ranking ISB agents can command stormtrooper squads, override orders of civilian and military authorities, replace questionable officers and commandeer Imperial military hardware. Loyalty officers of the ISB are tasked with ensuring that regular troops and officers obeyed orders and conformed to Imperial ideology. The Enforcement branch of the ISB served as backup for agents in the field, specially trained to provide support when necessary. Interrogation was the second-largest branch in the ISB, and was intent on extracting information from various lifeforms to obtain valuable information with 95 percent success rate. The Re-Education division is focused on brainwashing its subjects into supporting the Galactic Empire. The Internal Affairs division maintained order by investigating possible instances of insubordination within the Empire. Those in Investigations used previously collected data to suppress rebel activity.

entries.name: ISB high command
entries.content: ISB high command is a group within the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau.

entries.name: ISB Board
entries.content: The Commission of Operations, or ISB Board, is the governing body of the Imperial Security Bureau. Based out of the ISB Central Office in Imperial City, the Commission transmits assignments to the Sector Officer in charge of the relevant operational branch. Operations conducted between branches in the same sector or cross-sector operation were coordinated by the Commission of Operations.

entries.name: ISB Central Office
entries.content: The ISB Central Office is the headquarters of the Imperial Security Bureau that handled all of the communications and coordinations tasks for the organization. It's a massive office complex located in the Imperial City of Coruscant. The Commission of Operations transmits assignments through the Central Office to the Sector Officer in charge of the relevant operational branch. Operations conducted between branches in the same sector or cross-sector operation were coordinated by the Commission of Operations and directed by the Central Office.

entries.name: Mustafar
entries.content: Mustafar is a small planet located in the Mustafar system of the Outer Rim Territories, coreward of Rutan, between the Hydian Way and the Ninth Quadrant. A fiery volcanic world where an unusual type of lava was mined as a natural resource, Mustafar often serves as a place to dispose of unwanted evidence, a quality which drew Black Sun to the planet. It also drew the Sith. Mustafar served as the last capital of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Mustafar orbits the star Priate in the third orbital position between the gas giants Jestefad and Lefrani. With Mustafar orbiting closer to Jestefad and at a similar rate to both dueling planets, the two giants were involved in a gravimetric battle that, while tearing Mustafar apart, also prevented it from becoming a moon of either celestial body. A single rotation of the planet took 36 standard hours, and the planet orbited its sun once every 412 standard days, as well as the same number of local days. Mustafar had no moons of its own.

entries.name: Utapau
entries.content: Utapau is an arid sinkhole world in the Utapau system of the Tarabba sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Utapau was the homeworld of the Pau'ans and the Utai, more commonly referred to collectively as Utapauns. These species lived in the many giant sinkholes that dotted the planet's scrub-covered surface.

entries.name: Utai
entries.content: The Utai are one of two humanoid species native to the sinkhole world of Utapau. A stocky species with long eyestalks, the Utai willingly allowed the Pau'an species to rule them on their homeworld, serving as menial laborers in the sinkhole cities and caverns of their homeworld. Unlike their neighbors, the Utai had comparatively short lifespans.

entries.name: Pau'an
entries.content: Pau'ans are gaunt near-Humans native to the planet Utapau. Also known as Utapauns due to their long lifespans, they co-existed on Utapau with the Utai. The two species got along well, with the lanky Pau'ans assuming leadership roles on the planet. The Pau'ans opposed the Confederacy with the aid of the Republic, and later opposed the Empire, after Imperials took control of their planet following the Declaration of a New Order. The average member of the Pau'an species stood taller than a Human, at 1.9 meters. They are bald and their head are striped with furrowed gray skin. Pau'ans have large, sunken black eyes in red eye sockets and jagged, fang-like teeth used for tearing into raw meat, as they are carnivores. The Pau'an have pale, wrinkled skin. Pau'ans as a society are generally friendly, and are happy to welcome guests. Pau'ans have long lifespans, living up to 700 years. This earned them the nickname of "Ancients". Members of the species are able to see well in darkness. Pau'ans have five fingers and toes, but are more mobile than they appeared. They often wear elaborate clothes intended to heighten their impressive stature. Most Pau'ans spoke both Utapese and Basic. The Pau'ans fulfilled most of the governmental and administrative duties on Utapau, as the Utai did not desire such work, serving as laborers instead. Pau'ans are kind leaders, and sympathetic to their subordinates. Each Administrator served on the Utapauan Committee and oversaw planetary governance.

entries.name: Imperial Maritime Division
entries.content: The Imperial Maritime Division, referred as the Imperial Navy, is part of the Galactic Empire's Military that carried out operations on bodies of water of different planets. It was one of the important organizational distinctions of the Imperial Army, the ground forces of the Imperial Military.[2] The Navy's most notable actions were fighting in the battle for the Montrosa Islands and the Liberation of Kashyyyk

entries.name: Imperial Navy
entries.content: The Imperial Navy, informally referred to as "the Empire's long arm," is the space warfare branch of the Imperial Military of the Galactic Empire. It fields millions of warships, logistics vessels and fighters, manned by trillions of fleet crew. A command structure consisting of twelve Grand Admirals. The mainstays of its fleets are the Star Destroyer and Super Star Destroyer capital ships and the TIE fighter series of starfighters. The role of the Imperial Navy was the absolute dominance of known space in the name of the Empire, as well as enforcing the Emperor's will. Four key functions of the Imperial Navy includes blockading spaceports to cripple a planet's ability to fight, bombarding planets to destroy enemy infrastructure, guarding shipping lanes against pirates and smugglers to safeguard commerce and frighten criminals into conducing honest trade, and transporting and supporting other branches of the Imperial Military from space and from the air, supplying them with space and aerial support upon disembarkation if necessary. The highest organizational body of the Imperial Fleet is Naval Command and the Admiralty, the organizing body that directed all operations of the Imperial Navy. Naval Command took orders directly from the Emperor. On rare occasions, Naval Command also had direct involvement in military operations.

entries.name: Imperial High Command
entries.content: Imperial High Command, also known as Imperial Central Command or simply Imperial Command, was the central command division responsible for coordinating the Imperial Military of the Galactic Empire.

entries.name: Byss
entries.content: Byss is a mythic paradise world in the Deep Core, near the center of the galaxy, discovered no earlier than 45 BBY. A local day lasted 31 standard hours, and a local year lasted 207 local days. Byss itself is somewhat of a myth, seeming to be the perfect place to live. Its eerie blue-green glow, caused by its sun, also added to the strangeness of the world. Despite this outward appearance, the dark-side energies were everywhere, corrupting not only the inhabitants, but the planet itself. Byss was the secret throne world of Palpatine and the location of his towering Imperial Citadel. It's situated at the end of the Byss Run, a heavily guarded artificial hyperlane kept open by hundreds of non-mass S-thread boosters, connecting the planet to the Core Worlds. The planet is otherwise nearly impossible to reach safely through hyperspace, due to the high density of stars in the Deep Core and the constantly shifting patterns of the region's natural hyperlanes. Byss is the fifth planet of the Beshqek system and orbited the star Beshqek; it was one of two habitable planets in the system, the other being Relus. The planet was orbited by five small moons, which had little influence on its tides.

entries.name: Relus
entries.content: Relus was the fourth planet of the Beshqek system, located within the Deep Core. It was one of two terrestrial planets in the system and was orbited by a single moon.

entries.name: Hutt
entries.content: The Hutts were a sentient species of large gastropods with short arms, wide cavernous mouths and huge eyes, who controlled a large space empire in Hutt Space. The Hutts originally hail from the planet Varl, but no planet by that name appeared on any Imperial star charts. Their adopted homeworld was Nal Hutta. Members of this species were often stereotyped as crime lords. A Hutt was an immense slug-like creature that has a thick body with a long muscular tail with small arms located on the upper body. The large body has a bulbous head at the top. Hutts has no skeleton but instead had an internal mantle which supported and shaped their head. Young Hutts tended to have light tan skin and lacked greenish pigmentation on their spine that went down their tail as they aged. A Hutt's skin epidermis resists all but the most corrosive of chemical substances. Sweat made of oil and mucus made a Hutt slippery and difficult to grasp. Heavy layers of blubber and muscle protects the vital organs. Their slimy coating protected them from either chemical burns or heat. Hutts are resistant to many poisons and diseases and seldom fell ill. Sarlaccs are incapable of digesting Hutts, forcibly expelling them instead of eating them. Their body odor was strong enough to upset a sensitive human stomach. They have two enormous reptilian eyes and protruded from the surface of their face. Hutts are able to open their jaws to miraculous widths that allowed them to devour almost anything. They can see ultraviolet light. Hutts have multiple sex organs and utilized hermaphroditic reproduction. They needed no partner to produce a child. Hutts selected their own sex at will.

entries.name: Sarlacc
entries.content: Sarlaccs are semi-sentient, plant-like, large, omnivorous invertebrate with long tentacles that rimmed its mouth. Found on several planets across the galaxy. The Sarlaccs were unique among galactic species, having characteristics of both plant and animal. A sarlacc spent most of its life underground with only its mouth visible from the surface. It lived to be tens of thousands of years old, and reproduced by spores. After implanting itself into the ground, the sarlacci grew downward like a plant, forming a pit. The mouth and tentacles were the most visible parts of the sarlacc. The rest of the sarlacc's massive anatomical features were buried up to one hundred meters deep in the ground. The teeth of the sarlacc surrounded its beak-like tongue and plant-like tentacles in tiers. Its teeth were also slightly slanted inward. The sarlacc discharged odors and scents that lured herbivores and scavengers close enough for it to use its tentacles. The body of the sarlacc ended in three roots used for moisture absorption.

entries.name: Hutt Space
entries.content: Hutt Space, also known as the Hutt sector, is an autonomous region of the galaxy on the border between the Mid Rim and the Outer Rim Territories, near the entrance to Wild Space. It encompassed the Si'Klaata Cluster, and bordered on the Tion Hegemony. Hutt Space is named for the Hutt species, who dominated the region. Reasonable estimates of controlled planets are from a few hundred to a thousand inhabited worlds. Hutt Space is what remained of the ancient Hutt Empire. The Hutt Ruling Council controlled the region by overseeing the activities of the Hutt clans (kajidics) and their criminal syndicates. It's a lawless expanse within the Outer Rim Territories that was controlled by the most powerful and corrupt of Hutt clans. It holds an infamous reputation due to the widespread smuggling, piracy and open criminal activity. The heart of the region contained the Bootana Hutta, the "Garden of the Hutts", an area containing the various Kajidic throneworlds. Even in the Empire's days, this area remained secretive to outsiders, who knew it only through rumors.

entries.name: Nal Hutta
entries.content: Nal Hutta, also known simply as Hutta, is the capital of Hutt Space and was located in the Y'Toub system. It was formerly known as Evocar and was the original home world of the Evocii, who were ousted by the Hutts in 15,000 BBY. The planet is controlled by the ancient ruling Hutt families, who also ruled its moon Nar Shaddaa from Nal Hutta and became the new capital of Hutt Space. Nal Hutta is a very large planet, and lacked natural heavy metals. The planet was originally a lush jungle world with vast oceans, though the Hutts eventually transformed it into a polluted and barren wasteland. Much of the surface is covered by flat, marshy bogs, stagnant, muddy puddles and patches of sickly marsh grass inhabited by insects and spiders. Areas still habitable by the native species are viciously competed for making the many of the species on Nal Hutta some of the most aggressive animals in the galaxy. The atmosphere is polluted by strip-mining operations and heavy industrialization, and a greasy rain drizzled down on the surface. The capital city is Bilbousa and the Guarja Shipyards were located on the planet.

entries.name: Nar Shaddaa
entries.content: Nar Shaddaa is the largest moon of Nal Hutta. More commonly known as the Vertical City, the Smugglers' Moon, Little Coruscant, and as Narsh, Nar Shaddaa is similar to Coruscant in that its surface was entirely overgrown with city sprawl for millennia. Nar Shaddaa is filthy, polluted, and infested with crime everywhere. Nevertheless Nar Shaddaa remains the most important financial and trading center of Hutt Space. Nar Shaddaa is tidally-locked to Nal Hutta. The moon was also protected by planetary shields. Nar Shaddaa has large quantities of heavy elements like iron, nickel, neutronium, zersium, gold, plutonium and uranium in its core and crust. Nar Shaddaa’s surface highly urbanized ecumenopolis. For administrative purposes the cityscape of Nar Shaddaa was divided into many sectors, which in turn are divided into smaller districts. New layers of housing and entertainment buildings are built on top of older layers, which resulted in the construction of massive vertical cities reaching heights of up to three kilometres. Power plants and their massive exhaust pots, venting off the excessive heat, made the levels nearer to the moon's surface warmer and hotter. In total Nar Shaddaa has 100 levels of urban layers, of which the lower half made up what is known as the moon’s Undercity. The urban surface of Nar Shaddaa consisted of several docking towers, landing bays, cargo warehouses, factories, residential buildings, promenades and trading plazas. The inconsistently-shaped buildings, some cylindrical, some polygonal, looked like trunks of some growing organism, and the population around them like symbiotes. Nar Shaddaa is governed by the Hutt Cartel.

entries.name: Taris
entries.content: Taris is an urban planet in the fifth orbit of its star, located in the Taris system, within the Ojoster sector, of the Outer Rim Territories. Taris is orbited by four moons, including an anomalous moon nicknamed "Rogue Moon." The term Tarisian was used to describe people and products from the planet. The planet's ecumenopolis quickly developed over a century of prosperity, and as a result the planet suffered from massive overpopulation. Once a galactic nexus that earned great wealth from its strategic position on hyperspace routes, Taris' importance declined with the discovery of improved trade routes, and the planet rapidly fell into decay. The city became segmented, the lower classes were banned from living in the upper levels of Taris, and the planet became the poster child of a economically dying world. Much of the city has been rebuilt but never to the extent of it prior.

entries.name: Zann Consortium
entries.content: The Zann Consortium is a consortium and crime syndicate led by Tyber Zann. During the course of the Galactic Civil war, it amassed considerable power and wealth, eventually becoming a major nuisance—and even threat—to both the Empire and the Rebellion. The Zann Consortium gained most of its technology through its affiliation with the black market, and its Defilers, which were known for traveling to hostile systems and setting up illegal outposts which promoted piracy and sabotage. The Zann Consortium uses its extensive crime network to influence the warring factions, siphon their credits, and sabotage their operations when necessary. It deals in multiple illegal operations, such as establishing widespread racketeering jobs on many worlds; bribery, piracy, slavery, and corrupting local militia on planets, as well as intimidating or kidnapping individuals who defied the Consortium. One particular means of income was offering military protection to planets that wanted no part in the ongoing Galactic Civil War. They also extorted money from miners. The Consortium also constructed palaces on various worlds to serve as its financial centers. The Consortium has several unique technologies at it's disposal, including buzz droids and stealth generators, that allowed undetected movement across the galaxy. The Zann Consortium uses starfleets in space combat, utilizing both black-market technology as well as their own. Most of these were built at Consortium space stations. Though the Zann Consortium has a surprisingly well-equipped and organized military force, they generally preferred to use guerrilla warfare tactics or criminal activities to gain influence.

entries.name: Defiler
entries.content: Defilers are soldiers of the Zann Consortium employed as "undercover agents" dispatched to various systems to promote piracy and sabotage. Defilers would sabotage bases, set up connections with the black market, set up slave camps, steal credits, etc. What they are most familiar for was spreading the influence of Zann. Defilers are usually armed with a precise blaster rifles and thermal detonators, and preferred long-range combat. They worked well with the Droideka Mark II in destroying heavier vehicles, and could use their thermal detonators to kill entire squads of infantry. Defilers wear blood red full-body armor and helmets.

entries.name: Black Sun
entries.content: Black Sun is a criminal syndicate that came into prominence during the Clone Wars as the Jedi Order focused more on military affairs and less on law enforcement. Black Sun allied with the Shadow Collective and its leader, the renegade Sith Lord Maul. The syndicate maintained bases on Mustafar and Ord Mantell and had many of the Falleen species as members. Black Sun holds a massive amount of reach and influence, extending its tendrils of corruption deep in the various galactic governments. It's infamous for its involvement in piracy and smuggling. But smuggling was just the tip of the iceberg of the galaxy-wide organization; It's  involved in every known type of illegal activity. Its information networks, which reached even the garrisons and intelligence offices of the Empire, rivaled even the accuracy and scope of Imperial Intelligence. The resources available to Black Sun rivaled those belonging to a large planetary army, including foot soldiers. Below the leader of Black Sun were nine Vigos who coordinated their tens of thousands minions of the organization. Each Vigo ruled over his or her own territory and sector. Black Sun is known to have several hideouts in remote, scarcely populated planets of the Outer Rim Territories.

entries.name: Twi'leks
entries.content: Twi'leks are an omnivorous humanoid species originating from the planet Ryloth. They tended to eat cultivated molds, fungi, and rycrit meat. Their distinctive features included colorful skin, which varied in pigment from individual to individual, and a pair of shapely prehensile tentacles that grew from the base of their skulls. The tentacles, called "brain-tails", "lekku," "tchun-tchin", are advanced organs used for communication and cognitive functions. Twi'leks have a fairly standard humanoid vocal structure and were capable of learning most alien languages; they usually prefer their native language of Twi'leki, which incorporated subtle movement of the lekku. When they wished, they can even communicate in complete secrecy using their versatile brain-tails. Twi'lek females are often used as slaves or dancers because of their beauty.

entries.name: Ryloth
entries.content: Ryloth is the harsh, rocky homeworld of the Twi'leks, an Outer Rim Territories world located on the Corellian Run and forming one endpoint of the Death Wind Corridor. One side of the planet perpetually faced its sun and the other remained in darkness, a phenomenon known as tidal locking. The dayside was referred to as the Bright Lands and the night-side was known as the Nightlands. Ryloth has a thin, but breathable atmosphere. Ryloth is orbited by five moons, which have subtle tidal effects on the planet's liquid core and underground springs. Ryloth has little or no surface water except for patches of water ice on the night side. Ryloth has dry, rocky landscapes of deserts, mountain ranges with mist-covered peaks, shadowy valleys, alternated with snowy wastes, joined by lush temperate bands which concentrated much of its population. Because of its unusual day-night rotation period, atmospheric conditions on Ryloth's surface were characterized by turbulent seasons and extremely high winds (reaching 500 kilometers per hour) and unpredictable bursts of heat storms, which could reach 300 degrees Celsius. The Floating Rock Gardens of Ryloth is a natural wonder and tourist attraction, well known throughout the Outer Rim, where strong winds blew among the tunnels, causing rocks to float gently through the air. Over the years the gardens became filled with rare and dazzling stones. Visitors are allowed to rearrange the stones to their liking, but are encouraged to seek meaning in the natural configurations. Kala'uun is a permanent city located within the Lonely Five mountain range, boasting a large underground spaceport.

entries.name: Anzati
entries.content: The Anzati, or Anzat for singular, are dangerous and feared Force-sensitive near-Human species with two tentacle-like proboscises that curled out and extended from their cheeks, with which the Anzati were able to feed upon the brains of their prey. With the tentacles retracted into seams along each side of their nose, Anzati are indistinguishable from any other humanoid species in the galaxy. They are extremely long-lived, also having regenerative capabilities beyond those of the average humanoid. The Anzati are telepathic, growing more adept at the talent as they aged, allowing them to dominate someone's mind to give them a chance to feed. The soup that Anzati drank is the future, and thus, the Force. Because of this, Anzati who drank the soup of another Force-sensitive would strengthen their connection to the Force. The Anzati are Human in appearance, with bulbous noses, flared nostrils, and grayish-hued skin. They have no natural biorhythm; no pulse, and no body heat. It's a total mystery as to how their circulatory system functioned. The youngest Anzati were ancient. The ages of the eldest could be measured in eons. An Anzat who did not feed at least once every few days merely grew hungry. The Anzati are natural predators, preferring to hunt sentient races of every shape, size, and species.

entries.name: Diathim
entries.content: The Diathim are mysterious species of winged sentients who inhabited the moons of the planet Iego, specifically living on the largest moon, Millius Prime. Tall and beautiful, the Diathim have six wings and shining white skin. They are known as the Angels as a result of spacers mistaking them for that. Diathim are benevolent, peaceful and cautious around others, with stories of their reputed beauty being spread from the Outer Rim Territories to the Core Worlds. They are regarded as the most beautiful beings in the known universe. The Diathim are as if made of blazing white light tinged with a yellow aura, beings of pure energy. Diathim are slender, 2 to 3 meters tall feminine anthropoids with six blade-shaped wings protruding from their backs. Usually having milky white skin. The Diathim can fly and glide freely. Even able to fly in the vacuum of interplanetary space. They also have natural hypnotic abilities. The Diathim gave off an aura of kindness. The Diathim are fascinated by spacecrafts.

entries.name: Quermian
entries.content: Quermians are a mammalian species of sentients hailing from the planet Quermia after being genetically designed from Xexto DNA by the Arkanian race. Quermians are taller than their forebears and were left to evolve without any predators on their terraformed homeworld of Quermia. Equipped with long necks for peering over vegetation mats, bulbous heads with a permanently bemused smile, and two sets of spindly arms, they also have two brains, one located in the chest cavity. Their two brains could cause mental problems when each brain developed a different personality but also gave them a type of telepathy which they attributed to an ability to better observe and understand body language. The olfactory glands of this species were found in the hands.

entries.name: Arkanians
entries.content: The Arkanians are a near-Human species which resided primarily on the frozen planet of Arkania in the Perave system of the Colonies region of the galaxy. Arkanians considered themselves the pinnacle of evolution, and many are distinctly immensely arrogant. Arkanian scientists are experts in genetic manipulation for millennia, and are split into many sub-species. Most can pass for Human, the most pure of blood have pure white eyes and four clawed digits on each hand. Arkanians are capable of seeing into the infrared spectrum, and their eyes are sensitive to sources of extreme heat. Many are forced to wear blinders on planets with hotter, younger suns. It's not unusual for an Arkanian to enhance themselves with internal and/or external cybernetics. It's standard practice for Arkanians to undergo genetic manipulation of their own bodies, enhancing themselves so as to be better than "lesser" species. Even the slowest Arkanian is able to memorize entire libraries of knowledge and calculate problems that even the Galactic Empire's most advanced supercomputers struggled with. Arkanians are deeply offended by impoliteness, the offending individual needed to make amends quickly or risk being ostracized. When offended, an Arkanian typically spoke badly of the other party once they were gone and when no apology was given, even lock up the person or detain their starship from leaving the planet with overt threats. It's possible to redeem themselves in the eyes of an Arkanian though failure meant that they became even more offended and storm away. If successful, the individual needed to also offer a gift to the offended Arkanian as a sign of their sincerity. Knowledge and research is highly prized within Arkanian society, with many of the species being highly skilled scientists as well as academics. They are not above using their intelligence and research to gain profit.

entries.name: Arkania
entries.content: Arkania is the adopted homeworld of the Arkanian species. It's covered with tundra and rich in diamonds and other precious minerals, which the Arkanians mined to further their offworld connections and master their technology. Arkanian cities were designed to keep the cold out and were mostly completely enclosed. Off-world visitors rarely had to deal with the frigid conditions of the planet. Many citizens are miners. Arkania was able to sustain life and civilization despite the harsh climate. Deep underground, the planet is filled with diamond stores considered extremely valuable by those on the surface.

entries.name: Duros
entries.content: The Duros (occasionally Durosians) are a humanoid reptilian species native to the planet Duro who were among the galaxy's first space faring civilizations. Their homeworld is located on the Corellian Trade Spine, a major hyperspace route that linked Duro with other important commercial centers. The Duros are humanoids with smooth blue-green skin, red eyes, lipless mouths, long thin noseless faces and green blood. Olfactory organs beneath their eyes were responsible for their sense of smell. Both females and males are bald, though both sexes were easily distinguished. Their large red goggle-like eyes also have slit pupils. Duros females laid eggs as they were descended from ancient reptiles, and like the Neimoidians, they are born in a larval grub stage, but unlike their cousins who left the raising of their young mainly to the state, the Duros took care of their offspring from birth. While usually taciturn, Duros enjoy telling stories about their travels. Duros have photographic memory when it came to the telling of tales and stories. Many Duros are pilots and explorers, and are adventurous, though sometimes rash. As one of the first cultures to develop hyperdrive spacecraft, Duros-charted trade routes are among the oldest hyperspace routes still in use during the Imperial era. Duros are known for their superior astro-navigational skills. Their affinity for traveling led many Duros to prefer the honorific title of "Traveler" despite their occupation or craft of choice, and addressing them as such was considered good etiquette. The Duros language was Durese, which was a lingua franca of sorts amongst spacers. Many Duros took great offense at being compared to their Neimoidians cousins.

entries.name: Neimoidian
entries.content: Neimoidians are species of humanoids that are distant genetic relatives of Duros. They are native to the planet of Neimoidia and also lived on colony worlds in the same sector like Cato Neimoidia, Deko Neimoidia, and Koru Neimoidia. Neimoidians place tremendous value on wealth and material possessions, going to great lengths to gain money and power, resulting in a stereotype of being greedy and cowardly; they are very easily intimidated, and hated combat. Neimoidians have basic form, noseless faces, and green-blue skin. Their eyes also had pupils that split horizontally, and distinguished by small lumps on their foreheads and down-turned mouths. Their sense of smell came from glands under their eyes. A Neimoidian's lung pods expand and contract convulsively under great stress. Neimoidians have five fingers and two clawlike toes. Neimoidians are born in a larval state called a "grub" form. Neimoidians tended to be cowardly, greedy, and fearful of death. Neimoidians are notorious disease carriers. At several times in the past, Neimoidia had been quarantined and forbidden to travelers. Upon death, Neimoidian bodies would desiccate rapidly if not immediately buried or burned. The corpse's face would elongate, and the brain sac would shrivel into a series of tiny pods behind the head. Whenever they laughed, their head remained the same, but their body shook ever so slightly.

entries.name: Hapan
entries.content: Hapans are the near-Human natives of the Hapes Cluster. Hapans biologically similar to baseline Humans, but are more attractive and beautiful than typical Humans. The Hapans were isolated from the rest of the galaxy both culturally and genetically. Because most of the male population was largely wiped out by the Jedi around 4000 BBY, the Hapans is a matriarchal society and are ruled by a Queen Mother. The first Queen Mother closed the borders of the Hapes Cluster to the galaxy at large. Because of the perpetual daylight of Hapes and other planets in the Cluster due to the density of stars in the region, the Hapans had lost all ability to see in the dark, and were nearly blind even in dim lighting. Hapans are the descendants of the Lorell Raiders, a group of pirates. The Lorell Raiders, along with any other treasure they would plunder, would abduct beautiful Human women from all over the Galaxy and bring them back to Hapes. The native language of the Hapans is Hapan. The Queen Mother had the final say on everything, and her word is considered law. Most upper-class Hapans would think nothing of arranging the death of one of their own if it would advance their own cause. There is a class-based system within Hapan society. Women are accorded greater respect than men, and often treated as second class citizens. Treating one of lower status as an equal is foreign to their way of thinking. The Queen Mother is treated like a goddess. Candidates for the role of consort often came from the nobility, mainly to keep the gene pool vibrant. Anti-Jedi sentiment is rife among the Hapans. The Hapan people have deep love of beauty.

entries.name: Hapes Consortium
entries.content: The Hapes Consortium is a matriarchal monarchy of the Hapans in the Hapes Cluster, a closely packed star cluster located in the Inner Rim of the galaxy. Politically a consortium, it's based on Hapes and spanned 130 closely positioned star systems, each with at least one habited world. The Hapes Consortium is one of the galaxy's few insular civilizations, and have undergone a long period of isolation. Over the years, interaction between Hapans and the rest of the galaxy was extremely limited, due to their enforced isolation. At one point, the Consortium encountered the Galactic Empire but the Consortium were left to their own devices. The Consortium is an independent affiliate of the Empire. The Hapans are ruled by the Queen Mother, who held court at either the Fountain Palace when on Hapes, or aboard the royal transport ship Star Home when traveling abroad. The title of Queen Mother was hereditary, passed down from mother to daughter. If the Queen Mother failed to have daughters, the wife of the firstborn son became Queen Mother. Any threats made against the Queen Mother is ground for immediate execution. There are also representatives from each Consortium member planet at the Royal Court. Their main purpose was to vote on matters of importance and to give updates on any political and social conditions of their home planets that may require the Queen Mother's attention. The Queen Mother had the final say on everything, and her word was considered law. The Queen Mother's selection of a consort is important to all her people. Candidates for the role of consort often came from the nobility, mainly to keep the gene pool vibrant. The Consortium has a strong military and navy. One of the higher authorities amongst the Hapes Consortium is held by the Hapan Royal Guard. The Hapan Security acted as the primary Law enforcement agency for the Consortium. The Hapes Consortium has a vast amount of wealth. Hapan technology has advanced in some areas (ion technology) but had lagged seriously behind the rest of the Galaxy in others (turbolaser technology). The Hapan Consortium's designs held adequate shielding and hull integrity.

entries.name: Hapan Royal Guard
entries.content: The Hapan Royal Guard (Chume'doro in Hapan) is an elite security force of the Hapes Consortium. Its duties are to protect both the Queen Mother and the Hapan Royal House. As is typical of Hapan women, they are very attractive, but are also generally very large and strong, sometimes carrying enormous shoulder-mounted weapons. The Royal Guard is not a military unit but rather a police force with its agents quietly omnipresent. The Royal Guard are present on any naval vessel the Queen Mother might visit and one each of the worlds of the Hapes Consortium. Their objective is to investigate any possible threats against the Hapan Royal House. Though there was little to curb these powers, many Hapans willingly submitted to the authority of the Royal Guard, because Hapans see their ruler as a goddess and that her protectors were incorruptible. The Chume'doro are divided into two branches, the Royal and Investigative divisions. The Investigative branch operates by spying and surveillance and includes five sub-divisions; Surveillance, Interrogation, Forensics, Stealth and Purity. All members of the Royal Guard are experts in unarmed combat and trained in the use of weapons such as edge blades, polearms, and blasters. They use night-vision optics to compensate for their poor night vision.

entries.name: Hapan Royal House
entries.content: The Hapan Royal House comprised of the reigning Queen Mother and her close relations in the Hapes Consortium.

entries.name: Miy'til starfighter
entries.content: The Miy'til starfighter was a fighter unique to the Hapes Consortium, where it served as the primary superiority fighter for the Hapan Royal Navy. It employes an Astromech droid to assist with in-flight operations and navigation. The Miy'til was, like other small starfighters, relatively lightly armed, with only two laser cannons and one concussion missile launcher. A command version of the starfighter is more expensive, but equipped with another laser cannon, two ion cannons, and another missile launcher. Each Nova-class battle cruiser carried 24 Miy'til starfighters, while 36 were carried aboard a Hapan Battle Dragon. The Queen Mother's mobile palace Star Home carried 60 of the fighters.

entries.name: Nova-class battle cruiser
entries.content: The Nova-class battle cruiser is a capital ship that forms a large portion of the Hapan fleet. The Hapes Consortium had several different warships at their disposal. The backbone of their fleet was the distinctive Battle Dragon, but Nova-class battle cruisers are regularly used to supplement the Dragons. They are designed primarily as large-scale support ships, intended to respond to threats rather than undertake extended missions. The Nova-class battle cruisers are four hundred meters in length and were bristling with weaponry. The bridge of the ship is connected to a long neck-like body, with an "inverted-V" shape split-wing structure at the rear of the vessel. The bridge has a retractable wall-like shield that could be deployed for combat. Near the end of the ship's body is the hangar bay and main power core. The ion/hyperdrive engines and maneuvering jet arrays on the rear wings made it extremely swift at both sublight and light speeds. The main weapons of the cruiser are 25 turbolasers for use against capital ships, 10 laser cannons for dealing with starfighters or light freighters, and 10 ion cannons for disabling and capturing enemy ships. In its docking bays, a Nova cruiser carries two squadrons of Hapan Miy'til starfighters and six Hetrinar assault bombers.

entries.name: Hapan Battle Dragon
entries.content: The Hapan Battle Dragons are the premier warships used by the Hapes Consortium. The Battle Dragons are the primary capital ships of the Hapan Royal Navy, supported by Nova-class battle cruisers. The Hapan fleet containes at least 63 Battle Dragons, each representing one of the Consortium's worlds. Battle Dragons have  a unique dual saucer-shaped hull 500 meters in diameter with a central core connected by sixteen rotation support struts. The ships are armed with forty ion cannons and forty turbolaser batteries affixed to rotating circular sections on the top and bottom hull plates. To compensate for slowly recharging weaponry, the disc would rotate to bring fresh guns to an enemy while the previously used guns recharged their capacitors. Battle Dragons are armed with ten proton torpedo tubes, tractor beam projectors, dorsal- and ventral-mounted heavy triple ion cannon batteries and sixteen pulse mass mines launched from four pulse mass generator tubes. Each Battle Dragon carries three squadrons of Miy'til starfighters in onboard hangars and a battalion of 500 troops. The ships required a crew of 1,200 and 190 gunners. Battle Dragons have two serious flaws: The drive system could be damaged. And have only four targeting computers.

entries.name: Hapan Security
entries.content: Hapan Security is the primary law enforcement of the Hapes Consortium.

entries.name: Hapan Royal Navy
entries.content: The Hapan Royal Navy, also known as Hapan Fleets, Hapan Royal Fleet, is the primary military forces of the Hapes Consortium. The forces of Hapes have billions of warriors, thousands of starships. The Hapan Royal Navy is centered around a fleet of hundreds of Hapan Battle Dragons, with an honor fleet containing sixty-three, one representing each member planet of the Consortium. They are backed up by Nova-class battle cruisers and Beta Cruisers, as well as Miy'til starfighters, and Miy'til assault bombers. Hetrinar assault bombers are also sometimes deployed by Nova-class cruisers for defensive purposes.

entries.name: Beta Cruiser
entries.content: A Beta Cruiser is a type of battleship used by the Hapan Royal Navy. It's much smaller than the Nova-class battle cruiser, but also more maneuverable.

entries.name: Miy'til assault bomber
entries.content: The Miy'til assault bomber is a Hapes Consortium starfighter. Based on the same Hapan principles of speed and agility that produced the smaller Miy'til starfighter, the Miy'til assault bomber blends an impressive mix of sublight speed and maneuverability that put it on par with a heavy starfighter rather than a bomber. Because of its unusual speed and agility for a bomber, it's highly effective in both atmosphere and space, and was far superior to similarly classed bombers. The crew consists of the pilot, a gunner and an astromech droid. It's armed with 2 linked Laser cannons and 2 Heavy Concussion missile launchers. It's equipped with Shielding.

entries.name: Hapes
entries.content: Hapes is the homeworld of the Hapan. Surrounded by shimmering nebulae, and with seven moons in the sky after sunset, Hapes never knew the darkness of true night. Only a few small, neat cities are necessary to cater for the needs of the state bureaucracy and the Consortium's commercial and legal institutions, and much of the planet was an unspoiled wilderness of broad oceans, snow-peaked mountains and lush primeval forest, where tightly-controlled commercial fisheries and game-preserves were the major focus of Hapan activity. Located near the center of the Hapes Cluster. The surface is marked by large oceans, forests, and mountains. Much of the surface was untouched due to the Hapan love of beauty, with Hapans preferring to stay in cities such as Ta'a Chume'Dan, the capital city of Hapes. The Fountain Palace, also known as the Castle of Per'Agthra is the premier royal residence of the Queen Mothers. The fortress-palace serves as an ancient symbol of royal authority for the monarchy.

entries.name: Hapes Cluster
entries.content: The Hapes Cluster is a grouping of several hundred stars within the area of nebulous gases known as the Transitory Mists within the Inner Rim—an impediment to hyperspace navigation that had kept the stars of the cluster isolated from the rest of the galaxy from before 3000 BBY. This region's high density of stars, nebulae and moons bathed its worlds—particularly Hapes itself—in bright light, which, over the centuries, caused the Hapans to lose most of their night vision.

entries.name: Transitory Mists
entries.content: The Transitory Mists is a region of ionized space that surrounded the Hapes Cluster. They inhibited travel to and from that region, thus allowing for the isolated development of the Hapes Consortium and the hiding of their piratical ancestors, the Lorell Raiders. A few routes through the mists were known, however they were kept secret among the Hapan pirates who originally traversed them. This region finally opened itself up to the wider galaxy during the early days of the New Republic in the wake of Isolder's marriage to Teneniel Djo.

entries.name: Star Home
entries.content: The Star Home was the flagship of the Hapan Queen Mothers, one of the most unique and luxurious spaceships in the galaxy—literally a castle set among the stars, equipped with the military capabilities of a fleet carrier. The Star Home is a large ship, with the massive centrally oriented hull measuring 2,500 meters in overall diameter. But although visually imposing, the Star Home is actually rather fragile—even the rugged-looking basalt base had been extensively hollowed out internally, and structural integrity was retained by powerful molecular-shield generators. As well as simply holding the frame together, these were strong enough to allow the ship to fight its way out of an attack and escape unharmed to hyperspace. Although not designed primarily as a warship, the Star Home carries a relatively heavy defensive armament, including twenty turbolaser batteries, twenty anti-starfighter laser cannons, and six tractor-beam projectors. His deadliest weapons are his sixty Miy'til starfighters, which were housed along with the Queen Mother's personal shuttle in a suite of hangar bays located in the base of the main hull, between the roots of the encircling pylons. There are also servants aboard to do the women's bidding composed of heavily muscled, beautiful young men dressed only in loincloths. One-third of the volume of the basalt base was taken up by the Star Home's six Kerts-Bhrg power generators, capable of operating for a hundred years without a major overhaul. These drove four linked Froond-class hyperdrive engines and twenty-four sublight engines.

entries.name: Lorrdian
entries.content: The Lorrdians, a Human culture from the planet Lorrd in the Kanz sector, are genetically identical to baseline Humans. However, because their unique culture and history set them apart from other Humans, they were sometimes classified as Near-Humans. During the Kanz Disorders, the Lorrdians were enslaved by the Argazdan Myrialites who forbade them from speaking on pain of death. As a consequence, the Lorrdians developed a system of subtle gestures, facial expressions, and body postures to talk to each other. A sophisticated language known as kinetic communication. By the Imperial era, Lorrdians became among the galaxy's best mimics, able to imitate a wide variety of mannerisms and voices (even those of many non-Humans). Many were outspoken anti-slavery critics and activists who tried to ensure that the galaxy's populace did not forget the lessons of the Kanz Disorders.

entries.name: Zelosian
entries.content: Zelosians are sentient plants native to the planet Zelos II. Outwardly, Zelosians are nearly identical to Humans in height, build, hair and skin pigmentation, and their ability to grow facial hair. Because of this, Zelosians can keep their origins a closely guarded secret and are commonly misidentified as Near-Humans by outsiders. Zelosians are not able to interbreed with any other humanoid race as it was quite hard, but not impossible, to conceive. Zelosians have a number of plant-like characteristics. Their blood is green chlorophyllic sap. A large portion of the muscles of Zelosians are cellulose fibers. Zelosians consume vegetable and animal product-based foods, but can photosynthesize through their skin. They can survive one to two months on only sunlight and water. All Zelosians have emerald-green eyes. They are also night-blind, unable to see whatsoever in light dimmer than that provided by a full moon. They stay indoors after sunset and held many superstitions about the night (although their suspicions about zombies proved to be somewhat true, being actually caused by corpses reanimated by parasitic worms known as jumpers). Alcohol had no intoxicating effect on Zelosians. Refined sugar has a comparable one; a tablespoon would have affected Zelosians as four ounces of strong liquor might affect a Human. Zelosian culture is centered around the dichotomy between day and night. Dark is bad, while light was synonymous with good. They are very superstitious species, with numerous beliefs regarding luck.

entries.name: Chiss
entries.content: The Chiss are tall, blue-skinned Near-Human species from the planet Csilla in the Unknown Regions, best known to most Humans as the people to which Grand Admiral Thrawn belonged. Due to the remote position of their home territory in the Chiss Ascendancy, they remained largely an enigma to the rest of the galaxy, and contact with outsiders is limited. The Chiss have blue skin and glowing red eyes, the shade of which depended on the oxygen. The more oxygen present, the more intense the color of their eyes and skin tone. While their hair is typically jet black, on rare occasions it grays with age (most Chiss believed that the development of gray hair was an indication of the siring of exceptional children). Their blue skin, jet black hair and red eyes generally commands attention once they were in a crowd of regular humanoids, and made them physically striking and instantly recognizable. Male and female Chiss tended to be more powerfully built than Humans but exhibited the same variances as Humanoid sexes. A fully grown Chiss is typically between 1.7 and 2.1 meters in height. Chiss are in very good physical shape because of their active metabolism, which also prevent obesity. They can live up to 80 years; children are between ages 1 and 10, and they experienced a rapid growth spurt by which they are considered full adults. Those aged 63 to 79 were considered old.

entries.name: Cortosis
