entries.content: Cortosis is a very rare, brittle, fibrous material, the conductive properties of which would cause lightsabers to temporarily short out upon contact. Cortosis is useful material for anti-lightsaber melee weapons anda rmor, though with repeated strikes, a lightsaber could still cut through it. Cortosis is also resistant to blaster fire and all kinds of energy because it's hightly energy-resistant. Cortosis is extensively used in shadowtrooper armor and the Force-using group known as the Jensaarai. Cortosis is expensive to mine because it's rare and it had to be absolutely refined. Pure, unrefined, cortosis ore kills anyone who touched it. Miners have to have filtering equipment, or else the cortosis particles would accumulate in their systems, causing hair loss, sickness, and eventually death. Pockets of highly-combustible lethane gas often formed near cortosis deposits.

entries.name: Doonium
entries.content: Doonium is a heavy metal primarily used in starship hull construction. It gave ships such as those in the Imperial Navy their characteristic white-gray color. The Empire granted exclusive mining contracts to companies like Turlin Corp to provide the needed ore. Doonium is found and mined on numerous planets and asteroid fields around the galaxy.

entries.name: Jensaarai
entries.content: The Jensaarai is an order of Force-users from the Suarbi system, who arose during the Clone Wars. Their name is Sith for "followers of the hidden truth." Their philosophy and methodology was a blend of Sith and Jedi teachings. Their hierarchy loosely resembled that of the Jedi Order. During its creation and early years the Jensaarai were opposed to the Jedi, due to ignorance and the loss of their founder. Jensaarai philosophy and abilities are syncretistic; the mixture of Jedi and Sith teachings complemented each other perfectly. From their Jedi roots they are deeply honorable, disciplined, and respected those same traits in their enemies. From the Sith they learned the power of aggression, though not to the point of the dark side. One Jedi ideal the Jensaarai never abandoned is the defense of peace and justice. The Jensaarai fight with lightsabers, and are familiar with the lightsaber forms of combat. But they mostly focus on constructing their brass-coloured Sith-inspired combat armor. The Jensaarai constructed their lightsabers at an earlier stage in their training and see the construction of their armor as more important. Their armor is highly flexible suit of light armor, covered in spun cortosis fibers, capable of protecting a Jensaarai from lightsaber attacks. Though not a rule, it's common practice for armor to be styled on animals that are capable of adequately protecting themselves, such as a reek or Corellian sand panther. There were three ranks amongst the Jensaarai: apprentices, defenders, and the Saarai-kaar. The Saarai-kaar serves as leader of the Jensaarai.

entries.name: Singing Mountain Clan
entries.content: The Singing Mountain Clan was a Dathomiri Witch clan village located near the Singing Mountain on Dathomir and a bitter rival of the Nightsister clan. Its leader is Augwynne Djo. Gethzerion, the daughter of Augwynne Djo and the founder of the Nightsisters, used to be part of this clan before she was exiled for attempting to kill her mother.

entries.name: Abafar
entries.content: Abafar is a hot and remote desert world within the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. Its geography mostly consisted of empty, featureless plains, known as The Void, and a few urban settlements, such as the mining town of Pons Ora. Large geographic indentations crisscrossed its surface, although they were not clearly visible from space with the naked eye. Even though a desert, the planet possessed water and is one of the few suppliers of a type of volatile fuel known as Rhydonium. The town of Pons Ora, built lower than the surrounding ground level, is notable for its extraction of Rhydonium. Although the planet itself is scarcely populated, the settlement featured a wide array of immigrated species, such as Aleena, Aqualish, Dug, Human, Sullustan and a tentacle-faced species. Commercial activity is practiced, as evidenced by the existence of Game Go and the diner Power Sliders. Due to particulates in the atmosphere, sunlight reflected on the chalky, white surface produced a diffuse orange sky, and these conditions, combined with regolith properties in made the white dust on the ground hazy. Because of this, it was nearly impossible to cast shadows, leave tracks and tell the direction or time of day. Abafar has limited bio-diversity. The seemingly static landscape would at times be disrupted by the sudden stampede of a certain species of limber, flightless birds, known as Void Striders. The striders occasionally traveled in large packs across its barren expanses.

entries.name: Rhydonium
entries.content: Rhydonium is a volatile starship fuel. Highly explosive, it's dangerous to salvage and its fumes are harmful to human health. It could be found on Abafar, Kijimi, Morak, Saracor, and Tralgaria. Rhydonium appears like chrome. It can be scraped up and salvaged, but only under a high degree of safety measures, as rhydonium is dangerous to exposed skin. Inhaling rhydonium fumes can danage human vocal cords. Exposure can cause brain damage. Rhydonium explosions are extremely colorful. Because of the fuel's volatile nature, it's tricky to transport at ground level, necessitating a low speed otherwise the fuel would become agitated and explode.

entries.name: Lola Sayu
entries.content: Orbiting a single star, Lola Sayu is a volcanic and sulfurous planet located within the Lola Sayu system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belderone sector. Appearing with a beautiful purple glow from its orbit, the planet had suffered an unknown event that caused its molten core to be exposed, and continued to slowly fall apart for several millennia afterwards. The planet's gravitational field was littered with planetary debris that continuously floated its orbit and made spatial approaches difficult and dangerous. When it was discovered by the Galactic Republic, in 522 BBY, the galactic government and the Jedi Order constructed a maximum-security prison around oribit known as the Citadel. On its surface, the planet is dotted with caves, crevasses, hills and mountains, alongside river-like cracks that spanned to where the crust ended at its destroyed southern hemisphere, while also glowing with the heat of the lava from the planet's exposed molten core. The surface is also extremely treacherous and unpredictable, with several roads perilously closing in on the edges of lava flows that came from the southern side's vast Sulfur Sea, often leading travelers to labyrinth cave systems or dangerously steep valleys. Water is relatively scarce on Lola Sayu and neither plant or animal life are known to exist on the planet's surface. Lola Sayu is habitable and life-supporting to an extent, holding a breathable, oxygen-mixed yet thin atmosphere on its northern side.

entries.name: Chiss Ascendancy
entries.content: The Chiss Ascendancy, sometimes termed Chiss Space or the Chiss Empire by outsiders, is a portion of the galaxy just inside the Unknown Regions that was ruled by the Chiss. The Chiss are very xenophobic people, believing themselves to be superior to all other beings; this leading to an isolationist society. The Chiss rarely engage in trade with anyone from outside their borders. Despite their isolation and prejudices, Chiss goods, like charrics, can be found on markets. The Chiss are governed by an oligarchy of Four Ruling Families from House Palace, located in the city of Csaplar. House Csapla, House Nuruodo, House Inrokini, and House Sabosen. Each House with the families is headed by Aristocra who wore particular colors to indicate their clan and family loyalties. Standard and day-to-day decisions are made by a democratically-elected parliamentary body from each of the 28 colonies. Issues were siphonedup through the parliament to a cabinet of appointed governors, and then to the ruling families, where a decision made by the parliament and/or cabinet could be approved for action. Each of the extended ruling families are responsible for a set of government affairs to manage. The vast financial holdings of the Chiss keep their supply lines running and also provided them access to a number of independent shipyards which they used to keep their vessels on constant patrol. The military of the Chiss Ascendancy consisted of well trained and well armed force. Chiss believe in rigid discipline and they make use of superior technology. The Chiss see themselves as a bastion of order in a sea of chaos in the Unknown Regions.

entries.name: Csilla
entries.content: Csilla, the homeworld of the Chiss, is a cold terrestrial world of glaciers and snowy wastes located deep within Chiss Space. Csilla is orbited by three moons. Csilla is the capital of the Chiss Ascendancy and imported resources including foodstuffs, luxury goods, and technology from other Chiss colonies. A network of underground tube transports connected its largest city, Csaplar, to every other area on the planet, including other cities buried in the ice. Cities on Csilla were kept livable by heat from the interior of the planet. Csilla is also the center of Chiss politics; their Cabinet and Parliament could be found at the House Palace in Csaplar. The Csapla family was responsible for the distribution of resources to the populace of Csilla.

entries.name: Chiss Ruling Families
entries.content: The Ruling Families, or the Ruling Houses, also known as the Four Families, are a group of Chiss families that governed the Chiss Ascendancy. Their representatives composed the Council of Families. Each of the Ruling Families were associated with a specific color worn on the shoulder patches of the Defense Fleet uniforms of their officers and warriors. Each Family was responsible for a certain sector of Chiss government, and each had formal representatives with titles such as Aristocra and Syndic. In order of least to greatest privilege within a Ruling Family, Chiss family ranks were: Merit adoptive, Trial-born, Ranking distant, Cousin, Sibling. A family rank of shadow child also existed, which kept an individual with that rank completely secret, to prevent the complete extermination of a Ruling Family by their enemies. These titles are of literal blood relationships, but they can be awarded on merit, and while each Family is ultimately a kin-group, they also keep adoptive members who are not born into the oligarchy. Each Chiss Ruling Family have a fleet of warships used as planetary defense forces for a homeworld affiliated with that family referred to as Household Phalanxes.

entries.name: Csapla family
entries.content: The Csapla family, also called House Csapla, is a Chiss Ruling Family responsible for colonial affairs, agriculture, and distribution of natural resources throughout the Chiss Ascendancy. Of these responsibilites, distribution of resources to the Chiss homeworld of Csilla the twenty eight colonies of Chiss Space is the most important. The family's homeworld is the planet Cioral. Though heavily urbanized, it was from here that House Csapla managed the Ascendancy's half-dozen agricultural colonies.

entries.name: Nuruodo family
entries.content: The Nuruodo family, also known as House Nuruodo or the Second Ruling Family, is a Chiss kin-group from Naporar, one of the Ruling Families of the Chiss Ascendancy. It's responsible for foreign policy and military affairs, including the command of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force and the Chiss military units known as Household and Colonial Phalanxes. It's believed that the majority of contact that outsiders had with the Chiss was with agents from the Nuruodo family.

entries.name: Inrokini family
entries.content: The Inrokini family, also known as House Inrokini, is a Chiss Ruling Family responsible for industry, science, communication, and non-military or civilian technology. The family's homeworld was the planet Csaus, a hub of science and communications in the Ascendancy. An Inrokini family banner was adorned by a crest.

entries.name: Sabosen family
entries.content: The Sabosen family, or House Sabosen, is a Chiss house, one of the Ruling Families of the Chiss Ascendancy. It was responsible for social issues such as justice, health, and education.

entries.name: Sposia
entries.content: Sposia is a planet located in the Sposia system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. The hyperlane known as the Path of the Houses linked it to the Csilla and Naporar systems. Sposia was home to House Sabosen, one of the Ruling Families of the sentient Chiss species, and it was the site of the Chiss Ascendancy's top academies and medcenters.

entries.name: Csaus
entries.content: Csaus is a planet located in the Csaus system in the core territory of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Unknown Regions. It's home of the House Inrokini, one of the Chiss Ruling Families. Like other homeworlds of Ruling Families, Csaus is located on the Path of the Houses, a hyperlane that ran through the Ascendancy. The planet was the Ascendancy's hub of sciences and communications.

entries.name: Naporar
entries.content: Naporar is a planet located in the Naporar system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. The hyperlane known as the Path of the Houses linked it to the Ornfra and Sposia systems, while the Chasdemonus Route connected it to the Colonial Station Cam'co system. Naporar is home to House Nuruodo, one of the Ruling Families of the sentient Chiss species. It also served as the headquarters of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet and held the ranking authority in all matters related to the Chiss military units known as Household and Colonial Phalanxes.

entries.name: Cioral
entries.content: Cioral is a planet of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Unknown Regions and is located in the Cioral system. It's home of the House Csapla, one of the Chiss Ruling Families; therefore, as with many other homeworlds of Ruling Families, Cioral is located on the Path of the Houses, a hyperlane in the Ascendancy's core territory. Cioral is heavily urbanized planet from which a half-dozen Chiss agricultural colonies were overseen.

entries.name: Chiss warrior
entries.content: The Chiss warriors, also known as Chiss soldiers, Chiss troopers, are a core part of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force within the Chiss Ascendancy. Their primary purpose is to serve as security, the Ascendancy's primary military force and enforcing the borders of Chiss territories. Per the regulation standards for a Chiss soldier, the hair is supposed to be pulled severely back to the nape of a neck. Unlike the Chiss officers, a pair of silver bars indicating the owner's military rank are absent on the collar of the warrior's uniform. Although, warriors assigned to bodyguard duty wears a uniform with a pair of silver bars, vambraces, epaulets, a military shoulder belt, and an utility belt, similar to the Defense Fleet uniform. Chiss soldiers are equipped with maser-blaster rifles, and thermal detonators. They were transported from armored carriers. They also utilized advanced fractal-pattern armor in battle.

entries.name: Chiss officer
entries.content: Chiss officers are military officers who serve in the Chiss Ascendancy. Unlike the Chiss warriors, the officers wear a pair of silver bars on the collar of their uniform indicating the owner's military rank. Chiss Expansionary Defense Force officers are held to an incredibly high standard of physical fitness and mental acuity. Chiss officers that are part of either the Expansionary Fleet or the Defense Fleet wear specialized black Defense Fleet uniforms, which signified that the military drew its members from all of the Chiss families. The Defense Fleet officers are required to prove themselves similar to how the Ruling Families selected merit adoptives to be taken into the Defense Hierarchy. Those promoted to a senior rank are stripped of family name and privilege and made part of the Hierarchy in order to serve all Chiss without deference or prejudice. The Defense Hierarchy officers wear dazzling white uniforms. Chiss officers that are part of a fleet belonging to a Ruling Family wear uniforms in the color of their respective family.

entries.name: Maser
entries.content: A maser is a type of energy weapon, similar to but distinct from a laser. Masers uses kinetic energy as well as laser energy to damage a target. Although maser weapons are rare compared with lasers in mainstream Galactic civilization, the Chiss made extensive use of a blue-beamed maser, known in Cheunh as a charric.

entries.name: Fractal-pattern armor
entries.content: Fractal-pattern armor is form of body armor developed by the Chiss. Worn by the Chiss commandos, fractal-pattern armor uses specialized coating to create ever-changing patterns and colorations on the surface, making it almost invisible to the naked eye.

entries.name: Chiss Defense Fleet
entries.content: The Chiss Defense Fleet is one of the internal defense fleets of the Chiss Ascendancy's Expansionary Defense Fleet, that along with the Household and Colonial Phalanxes, is charged with repelling aggressive incursions and considering long-term strategic concerns. Both the Expansionary Fleet and the Defense Fleet wear specialized black Defense Fleet uniforms. Unlike the starships of the Expansionary Fleet which are equipped with more powerful transmitters, the Defense Fleet vessels relied on a colony system's network of boosters and repeaters, and were equipped with lesser transmitters.

entries.name: Phalanx
entries.content: A Phalanx, also referred to as a Household Phalanx or Colonial Phalanx, is the primary division within the military of the Chiss species, separate from the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. There are 28 Phalanxes, one to defend each of the central colony worlds, and command of each Phalanx typically fell to an officer appointed by the Syndic of one of the Ruling Families. Phalanxes assigned to the headquarters of the Ruling Families are referred to as Household Phalanxes, as opposed to Colonial Phalanxes. The planet Naporar, homeworld of the Nuruodo family, held the ranking authority in all matters related to the Household and Colonial Phalanxes. In times of crisis, the Defense Fleet would call upon the forces of nearby Phalanxes.

entries.name: Chiss Expansionary Defense Force
entries.content: The Chiss Expansionary Defense Force (CEDF) is the primary military force of the Chiss Ascendancy. The Chiss Expansionary Defense Force is divided into two distinct subdivisions: the Expansionary Fleet in charge of frontier patrols and exploratory missions in areas around the Ascendancy. The Defense Fleet in charged with repelling aggressive incursions and considering long-term strategic concerns. In the presence of outsiders, members of the Defense Fleet and the Expansionary Fleet referred to their forces by the full name of the Chiss military force: the Expansionary Defense Fleet. The CEDF also provides a role during the Chiss political decision making process as they gave the deciding vote whenever there is a deadlock between the Ruling Families over the best course of action to take during specific events. Standard CEDF officers wear black uniforms with patches colored to relate to their houses; members of the Hierarchy wear all-white uniforms. The fleet uses starfighter carriers, armored personnel carriers, heavy gunboats, and assault cruisers. Chiss Star Destroyers, and AirStraekers are used by the force. Transports included drop ships and assault shuttles. Chiss commandos wear fractal-pattern armor and carried demolition satchels and charric guns. They are deployed on specialist tasks. Other variants include sharpshooters, pilots, and soldiers. The force made use of superweapons, such as the biological doomsday weapon; the parasite bomb. They also use radiation bombs. Chiss Defoliator is developed as well.

entries.name: Chiss Expansionary Fleet
entries.content: The Chiss Expansionary Fleet is the external defense fleet of the Chiss Ascendancy's Expansionary Defense Fleet that's charged with patrol of the Ascendancy's borders. The Expansionary Fleet is governed by the Expansionary Fleet's charter which only permitted observation and exploration in the regions around the Ascendancy. The Expansionary Fleet wear specialized black Defense Fleet uniforms. Unlike the starships of the Defense Fleet which were equipped with lesser transmitters and relied on a colony system's network of boosters and repeaters, the Expansionary Fleet vessels were equipped with more powerful transmitters.

entries.name: Chiss Ruling Circle
entries.content: The Ruling Circle, also known as the Chiss Ruling Circle, or the Ruling Council is the governing body of the Chiss Ascendancy. The membership of the Ruling Circle was selected from the Ruling Families.

entries.name: Charric
entries.content: The Charric is a Chiss ranged energy-weapon analog to the blaster, notable for utilizing maser-beam technology. The charric denotes personal weaponry in the Chiss Ascendancy, referring to handheld weapons ranging in size from pistols to rifles. Occasionally, the term could can refer to larger vehicle mounted weapons and artillery-grade pieces, such as Maser fans and Megamasers. Charrics fire a maser beam, which carry significant thermal and kinetic energy. Creating a potent bolt that was easily capable of penetrating non-metallic armor. Against metallic armors, the maser bolt creates a nasty electrical discharge capable of temporarily stunning or even knocking a target out cold. Charrics on their own are not capable of switching between a lethal and stun setting. Variant models of charrics did include a stun function, when set on stun these variants shut off its maser and emitted a green EM-charge designed to disrupt neurological patterns. Charric discharges are actinic blue or bright green, with slightly shorter ammo capacity and range than blasters. Charric are unable to be reflected by lightsabers.

entries.name: Miraluka
entries.content: The Miraluka are a Near-Human, Force-sensitive species. Their language was Miralukese, although some prefer Basic. The Miraluka differed from Humans in that they lacked eyes, only retaining vestigial eye sockets, and perceived the environment around them through Force sight instead of regular vision. This vision was so strong that if a Miraluka looked upon a Jedi or Sith, they could "see" Force radiating off them. The strength of a Miraluka's connection to the Force varied by individual. Miraluka can interbreed with baseline humanity. Such mating would result in difficulties for the offspring. The Miraluka are thoughtful, cautious, and deliberate species, known for their lack of greed and having little interest in personal gain or glory. Most Miraluka tend to conceal their vestigial eye sockets by wearing a headband, mask, or similar concealing headwear. All Miraluka are very united by race. They often called themselves "brothers" and "sisters", and considered each other members of a greater family. Miraluka are often shocked if 'shown' life not connected to the Force. Many Miraluka worship two gods, Ashla and Bogan, through the philosophy of the Greater Force. Miraluka do not believe in good or evil, teaching to accept both life and death. The Miraluka have their own order of Force-sensitives, the Luka Sene.

entries.name: Alpheridies
entries.content: Alpheridies is a planet in the Abron system, homeworld of the Alpheridians, and the adopted homeworld of the Miraluka. Alpheridies is located at the edge of a giant molecular cloud called the Veil. The Abron system's red dwarf star emitted energy mostly in the infrared spectrum. Gradually the Miraluka settled across the entire planet, focusing their civilization on agriculture so they required little in the way of offworld commodities. Though small industrial sections arose in a few population centers, the most advanced technologies manufactured on Alpheridies included only small computers, repulsorlift parts, and farming equipment. The Miraluka follow an oligarchic form of government in which all policies and laws are legislated by a council of twenty three representatives, one from each of the planet's provinces. State legal codes are enforced by local constables - the need for a national force never came about. Few Miraluka left Alpheridies. Most are content with their peaceful lives, and had no desire to disrupt the equilibrium. Over the centuries, many young Miraluka experienced an irrepressible wanderlust that led them off planet. Those Miraluka encountered away from Abron usually had a nomadic nature, settling in one area for only a short time before growing bored with the sights and routine. Some Miraluka did eventually settle down elsewhere. The Miraluka have at least one colony world, Katarr.

entries.name: Miraluka homeworld
entries.content: The Miraluka homeworld was rendered uninhabitable because it was unstable and began losing its atmosphere to space.

entries.name: Luka Sene
entries.content: The Luka Sene is formal Miraluka Force organization with meditation and education chambers in most cities on the Miraluka homeworld of Alpheridies. While all Miraluka use the Force to sense the world around them, some Miraluka did have an increased sense-based aspect of the Force. When these Miraluka are identified, Miraluka educators and leaders encouraged them to join the Luka Sene. Academic in atmosphere and culture, the Luka Sene focus primarily on developing the sense-related powers of their members. It did not dictate a member's personal life. Luka Sene members are present in all aspects of society and all fields. Most members only have small degrees of increased senses which they used to improve their own lives, careers, and Miralukan society. Those with higher degrees of sensitivity can become Administrators, Masters, or Mentors in the Luka Sene organization. A small amount left their homeworld to join the Jedi Order. The Luka Sene disapprove of the dark side and serve as guiders and guardians to protect Miraluka from falling to the dark side. The Luka Sene place heavy emphasis on the light side and practical sides of the Force. If a Miraluka is suspected of having fallen to the dark side, the Luka Sene would dispatch Sene Seekers to search out the individual and attempt to redeem the individual. If it's beyond redemption, the Sene Seekers (who would be accompanied by security personnel) would attempt a live capture. Elimination of a fallen individual is only carried out if no alternatives are open. Luka Sene can use Farsight with great skill, and have unique power known as Field Detection, allowing them to perceive energy fields.

entries.name: Empire of the Hand
entries.content: The Empire of the Hand is a political power located in Wild Space of the galaxy and had its planetary capital on Nirauan. Secretly founded by Grand Admiral Thrawn, the Empire of the Hand was established in order to protect the Unknown Regions from the many threats residing there. Thrawn commandeered efforts to map great swathes of territory as well as overseeing colonization and developing connections with the various species. Thrawn established a new hidden military and political force to provide order and security, laying the groundwork for the Empire of the Hand. The Empire of the Hand composed of Chiss that adopted the order and efficiency of the Galactic Empire, but without the Emperor's megalomania, the Tarkin Doctrine, and the institutionalized xenophobia. The Empire of the Hand operated like a confederacy and allowed its natives subjects self-rule in Wild Space. It accepted the alien races into the ranks of their military. The Empire of the Hand's Imperial Military ethics are based on Thrawn's vision of war. It's a combination of Chiss and Imperial tactics personally arranged by the Grand Admiral, such as respect of the enemies, careful consideration of soldiers' lives, surgical strikes, demonstrative invasions, preventive strikes and the significant use of intelligence gathering. With the combined technologies of the Galactic Empire, and the Chiss, the Hand develops new fighters. These would be called Nssis-class Clawcraft. The maser, a strong and powerful kinetic energy is developed as well. A-Racks is also developed, they served as trooper carriers.

entries.name: Yuuzhan Vong
entries.content: The Yuuzhan Vong, also known to the Chiss and Ferroans as the Far Outsiders, and sometimes abbreviated to Vong are a nomadic extra-galactic sentient species. The Yuuzhan Vong are descended from an ancestral species from the planet Yuuzhan'tar in a distant galaxy. A typical Vong resembled a Human in form, but are taller, heavier, and had less hair on their heads. The Vong are religious zealots, viewing mechanical technology as blasphemy. Their technological innovations are genetically engineered and purely organic. The Vong deeply respected pain to the point of sadomasochism and strove to improve their physical capabilities through organ grafting. Such grafting was a status symbol within Yuuzhan Vong society. The Vong are unable to be sensed through the Force, but are susceptible to some Force based attacks. Vong have sloping, almost ridge-like foreheads and pointed ears. Yuuzhan Vong have short, stub-like noses. The Yuuzhan Vong usually have black hair, but often wore it much longer than them. Small blue sacks can found under their eyes, and are considered a mark of beauty. These eyesacks expanded and contracted to reflect a Yuuzhan Vong's mood. The most common skin tone is gray, with the second most common being yellow. They have jet black blood. The Vong nervous system is very conductive. Yuuzhan Vong culture is centered around sacrifice and their gods, although warriors are centered on the philosophy of pain. They tended to glorify pain as a state of living. By remaking their own bodies, they are closer to their deities. But never maimed their bodies in a manner that would permanently hinder their ability to function. Devotional practices to the gods called for bloodletting at prayer times. Shamed Ones are forbidden from attending religious ceremonies. As a Vong grew more successful, they start to sacrifice body parts and replacing them with organs from another creature, enhancing their abilities. If the implant was accepted into the body, Vong ispromoted to a higher rank. If the implant failed to be accepted into the body, it's either in death or becoming a Shamed One. Such failures are believed to be the work of the Yuuzhan Vong gods. Family is a strong element within their society. A Vong is associated with a family group, known as a Domain. Some Domains are more powerful than others. The Vong use a caste based system for warriors, shapers, priests, intendants and workers. Love affairs between two different castes is forbidden. According to Vong religion, life was suffering, and death was the ultimate release from that suffering. The Vong greatly believe in honor.

entries.name: Mirialan
entries.content: Mirialans were a species of near-Humans native to the planet Mirial. Their appearance varied from yellow-green skin to paler skin very similar to many Humans. Mirialans were very flexible and agile, making them fast and formidable foes. Mirialans are nearly physiologically identical to Humans. The greatest difference in their biology was their green skin, great agility and extremely quick reflexes. The latter traits gave them the upper hand over Humans in terms of reaction time, athletics and martial arts. The Mirialan people are deeply religious and practiced a primitive understanding of the Force. They believed each individual's actions contributed to their destiny. Mirialans place unique, often geometrically repeated tattoo on their face and hands to signify that they had completed a certain test or task, or achieved sufficient aptitude for a certain skill. The number of tattoos is indicator of how mature and/or skilled a Mirialan is. Mirialan society is stratified and allowed the heavily marked citizens to access greater opportunities.

entries.name: Mirial
entries.content: Mirial was a cold, dry planet located near the Hydian Way.

entries.name: Zabrak
entries.content:
Zabraks are carnivorous, near-human species native to Iridonia, a planet located in the Mid Rim known for its inhospitable terrain and fierce predatory fauna. Zabraks inhabited several other colony worlds, including Feldrona, Frithia, Iridia, and Lorista. They are known for having a fierce sense of self-determination paired with an equally strong independent streak. Zabraks have series of vestigial horns that crowned the heads of both males and females. These horns developed at puberty, growing in varying patterns based on subspecies. The various Zabrak subspecies could also be identified by the patterns their horns grew in. They shared some eye pigments with humans, such as blue, green, and grey, Zabraks also have distinct eye colors, such as orange and bright yellow. The Zabraks were divided into two visually distinct cultural groups: Zabraks from Iridonia, had horns that are stumped, and resembled humans closely. Their skin tones ranging from pale to dark brown, and fairly common human hair colors that included blonde, brown, red, and black. The second group has sharper, more jagged horns, and are more distinct from humans, with skin tones that included red, yellow, and orange, as well as hair color that ranged from bright red to black. 
Zabraks typically covered their bodies in ritual tribal tattoos that symbolize many things, like family lineage, place of birth, or their individual personalities. Zabraks have a second heart. They have great resistance to physical pain. Zabraks are capable of breeding with humans.

entries.name: Iridonian
entries.content: The Iridonians, colloquially called Iridorians, are warrior people with a particularly bloodthirsty reputation. Most galactic citizens feared them. The Iridonians are rivals to the Echani and Mandalorian cultures. The Iridonians are a sentient, humanoid species with opposable thumbs and hearts. Iridonian society is based on a lust for bloodshed and violence. The Iridonians dismissed the code of honor Echani held dear, while they despised the Mandalorians for prioritizing credits over bloodshed. They were believed to continue attacking opponents' bodies even after a victim's death. The Iridonians manufactured specialized weapons and armor for their own use, with those designs officially being outlawed. Such items commanded a premium.

entries.name: Echani
entries.content: The Echani are Near-Human species from the Inner Rim planet Eshan. The Sun Guard arose from the Thyrsian subspecies of the Echani. The Echani have similar anatomy to humans, but are physically distinct due to their light skin, white hair and silver eyes. They have themselves a remarkable similarity to each other in their body type and facial features, with close family members often beomg indistinguishable to an outside observer. The Thyrsian subspecies of the Echani shared few of these traits, possessing dark hair and skin, rather than the white hair and silver eyes the Echani became known for. Due to the all-encompassing use of combat in all levels of their culture, Echani Generals are seen by others as having the ability to predict their opponent's next move. The Echani are matriarchal caste-based society, governed by the all-female ruling council of the Echani Command. The Echani have kinetic communication style and can instantly identify an individual through subtle shifts in body language. This sensitivity translates well to physical combat. Echani hold the belief that to know one fully, you must fight them. Echani fighting is not only self-defense, but truest form of self-expression, a means of communication similar to art. The Echani  focus on unarmed combat and melee weapons. They have excellent craftsmen of melee weapons. The Echani largely eschewed the use of heavy armor, preferring to fight in light armor, whilst they trained in minimal clothing. Their fighting style focused more on agility and movement.

entries.name: Umbaran
entries.content: Umbarans resided on the dark world of Umbara deep within the Ghost Nebula. Umbarans can see in ultraviolet (below 300 nanometers) and have the ability to read, subtly influence, and sometimes control the will of others. Umbarans are gaunt, frighteningly pale near-Humans with achromatic sunken eyes. Male Umbarans stand between 1.7 to 2.0 meters tall. Due to Umbara's eternal twilight, their eyes are well adjusted to the dark, but they were easily disoriented when exposed to sudden bright flashes of light. Umbarans spoke the language Umbarese which was written using the Umbaran alphabet. Umbarans are highly isolated and manipulative. Many have darker sense of humor, which would manifest in social interactions. Masters of misdirection, Umbarans almost never revealed their true thoughts or intentions. Umbaran society is built on a finely detailed caste system comprising almost one hundred levels. Only those in the top ten caste levels are given the opportunity to leave their homeworld. The primary ambition of the average Umbaran is to ascend through the caste levels, using tactics from blackmail and subterfuge to assassination. Failed plots to ascend the ranks of society are met harshly and their family dropped to one of the lower caste levels. Successful maneuvering is rewarded with prestige. The highest caste level, the Rootai, comprised a council that ruled Umbara, and its members are royalty. The Umbarans have their own military known as the Umbaran militia, which protected Umbara and the Umbarans from invasions.

entries.name: Umbara
entries.content: Umbara is a perpetually dark planet within the reaches of the Ghost Nebula. It's home to the Umbarans. It was also the site of a large battle during the Clone Wars.

entries.name: Umbaran militia
entries.content: The Umbaran militia is the local defense force of Umbara. The militia is comprised of the planet's native Umbaran people, who utilized their advanced technology that had been developed on their world to defend their holdings and attack enemy forces. Aside from the soldiers who served as infantry units, the militia also made use of millicreep assassin droids, heavy hover tanks, multi-legged assault tanks, and massive and mobile heavy cannons. The Umbarans also employed air defense vehicles, including their technologically-unique starfighters and combat support ships.
